data.title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer

experience_requirements.text: 8+ years of hands-on experience in application architecture and development

data.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Senior Director, Engineering in the IAM department. Identity has become the new security perimeter, and in this role, you will develop workflows and application integrations in collaboration with the broader IAM team, Product Management, and Business teams. You will be responsible for the design and development of enterprise-grade Identity Management Products for Zscaler, helping organizations worldwide harness speed and agility with a cloud-first strategy.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Design and develop enterprise-grade Identity Management Products for Zscaler
  • Participate in the design and implementation of core product functionality and key technical initiatives
  • Mentor junior engineers with software development best practices
  • Help maintain our positive culture as a collaborative and supportive teammate
  • Collaborate across teams to deliver projects from inception to production

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You are comfortable building the path as you walk it, viewing dynamic environments as opportunities to construct meaningful solutions.
  • You act like an owner. You operate with a strong sense of ownership, bringing passion for the mission, high integrity, and the capability to navigate between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a proactive problem-solver. You run toward challenges and remain laser-focused on finding solutions that deliver high-impact outcomes.
  • You build high-trust collaboration. You prioritize team success, welcome feedback, and practice clear, respectful candor to establish strong partnerships.
  • You maintain a continuous growth mindset. You actively seek feedback and development opportunities to grow as a partner, teammate, and purpose-driven leader.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in application architecture and development
  • Expert-level technical knowledge of Enterprise Java, OOP, OOA, systems architecture, RESTful APIs, and related frameworks such as Hibernate and Spring
  • Strong knowledge of Identity and Access Management protocols, specifically SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect
  • Experience developing enterprise-grade Security or Networking products

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and container infrastructure
  • Experience with Java reactive programming

We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

data.title: ICT Designer (Canada)
data.description:
Location: Canada, Remote

Industry: Mission-Critical Facilities, Data Centers

Engagement Type: Full-Time

Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O’Brien, is seeking an experienced ICT Designer to lead the design and coordination of structured cabling, low-voltage, and telecommunications systems for hyperscale and AI data centers across North America. This is a remote position within an international engineering firm recognized for its innovation and expertise in mission-critical infrastructure.

Our projects involve large-scale, high-demand facilities with complex structural, electrical, mechanical, automation, and security systems, often exceeding 100 MW per facility and up to 500 MW per site.

Role Summary:

We are seeking a skilled ICT Designer who will be responsible for developing and coordinating low-voltage systems such as structured cabling, telecommunications, security, and data networks, ensuring they are fully integrated within the overall building design. This role involves producing detailed design documentation, performing engineering calculations, developing system layouts, and ensuring design accuracy using BIM and ICT engineering tools. You will collaborate closely with electrical, mechanical, and BIM teams in a multidisciplinary environment, contributing to the full project lifecycle from schematic design through construction documentation and coordination. Strong technical knowledge, attention to detail, and excellent communication skills are essential.

WhatWe Offer:

  • Experience in a high-tech industry within an international company
  • Unique, cutting-edge data center projects
  • Comprehensive training
  • Professional development support
  • Supportive management and a dynamic team environment
  • Career growth potential
  • Ability to work from home
  • Comprehensive compensation package
  • Competitive employee benefits: Health insurance (Medical, HSA & FSA, Dental, Vision), Life insurance, Short-term and long-term disability, many other benefits, including PTO.
  • Opportunity to participate in the company’s retirement plan
  • Stock ownership / synthetic equity options

What You Will Do:

  • Designing and coordinating ICT and low-voltage systems including structured cabling, telecommunications, access control, video surveillance (CCTV), and security systems
  • Using BIM tools to model and coordinate ICT systems with other engineering disciplines using tools such as Autodesk Revit – is a must
  • Developing a thorough understanding and delivery of the project requirements as they relate to scope, cost and schedule
  • Determining and expediting the engineering deliverables for projects
  • Developing and maintaining project scope of work documentation and revisions during design development
  • Preparing engineering calculations, system layouts, and technical documentation for ICT infrastructure
  • Preparing technical documentation required for project execution including design criteria, technical specifications, and equipment data sheets
  • Reviewing shop drawings and contractor submittals
  • Producing models and drawings using BIM and CAD modeling tools
  • Supporting coordination with multidisciplinary engineering teams during project development and execution

What We Expect:

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, telecommunications, IT, or a related field
  • Proven expertise as an ICT / telecommunications / low-voltage systems engineer
  • Written and spoken English B1 and higher
  • Experience in ICT design including structured cabling systems, telecommunications infrastructure, and security systems
  • Experience designing low-voltage systems for industrial, commercial, or mission-critical facilities
  • Experience using BIM modeling tools and design software
  • Hands-on experience using Autodesk Revit – is a must
  • Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering environments
  • Understanding of telecommunications standards and low-voltage system codes
  • Microsoft Office proficiency (Word, Excel, Outlook)
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize while meeting project deadlines
  • Self-starters that are ambitious and thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to communicate technical knowledge in a clear and understandable manner
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Optional site visits if desired (no required travel)
  • Authorization to work in Canada

Join Us:

Our commitment to innovation drives us to deliver superior services to our clients using advanced tools and software.

We offer a dynamic environment fostering creativity through exposure to diverse technologies and experiences, ranging from designing energy-efficient facilities and site supervision for multi-million-dollar facilities to the production of digital twins, three-dimensional building modeling, computational fluid dynamics, and the development of custom controls software.

Join our team at Ehvert Mission Critical, now a proud part of Salas O'Brien, and help us achieve our international engineering goals!

For more information, visit Ehvert and Salas O'Brien.

data.title: Engineering Manager, Experimentation

experience_requirements.text: 3+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 2 years managing a team of backend or infrastructure engineers

data.description:
About the Job:

We're looking for an Engineering Manager for our Experimentation team. In this role, you'll lead the team that builds and operates the core Experimentation product, from setup to results processing and display.

LaunchDarkly’s Experimentation team is building one of the company’s most strategic product areas: a platform that helps leading engineering organizations move beyond intuition and make product decisions with real statistical confidence. Sitting at the intersection of large-scale systems, data science, and user experience, the team is creating a best-in-class experimentation product that lets customers set up, manage, and analyze experiments with ease while still earning the trust of even the most rigorous data teams. From warehouse-native analysis to experimentation workflows built on top of LaunchDarkly’s massive feature management scale, this team is tackling ambitious technical problems with visible customer impact and a clear opportunity to define the future of modern software experimentation

As the Engineering Manager, you'll bring a balance of people management and technical leadership as you drive the development of the multiple services that power this product and foster a high-performing, collaborative engineering culture.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, providing coaching, feedback, and career growth opportunities

  • Partner with PM and Design to scope, estimate, and sequence roadmap items, making scope tradeoffs in real time.

  • Own the team's delivery of features, ensuring completion within timelines and quality requirements.

  • Collaborate with adjacent teams (Warehouse Integrations, Metrics, and Guardian) on shared infrastructure decisions and cross-team dependencies

  • Communicate roadmaps, risks, and progress clearly to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders

  • Build team working norms that promote collaboration, reduce silos, and keep engineers engaged

  • Drive operational excellence — improve reliability, observability, and incident response for production data infrastructure

  • Participate in hiring to grow the team and raise the engineering bar

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 2 years managing a team of backend or infrastructure engineers

  • Proven ability to partner with Product Management to translate business goals into engineering plans with reliable estimations

  • Strong communication skills, especially in distributed team environments with cross-timezone collaboration

  • Track record of coaching and developing engineers, including performance management, career growth planning, and technical mentorship

  • Familiarity with observability practices (metrics, tracing, alerting, structured logging) and comfort with production incident response

  • Experience with Go or comparable backend languages (Java, Python, Rust) is a plus

  • Familiarity with data warehouse platforms (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks) and data pipeline tooling (Airflow, Prequel) is a plus

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰 £138,000 - £175,000 + Equity + Benefits

About the Role

This role is for a Senior Engineering Manager where you’ll be a manager of managers. You will be leading across multiple teams in an org of around 20-30 people. We’re expanding and your role as the Senior EM will be to grow and build new squads as needed. Your direct reports will include Tech Leads, Senior Engineers and 2-3 Engineering Managers.

Senior Engineering Managers at Monzo are part of cross-functional, autonomous teams and groups. Our teams are mission driven, and typically include Product Managers, backend, web and mobile engineers as well as data scientists, designers and subject matter experts relevant to that mission. Teams are organised into groups, and then collectives - we aim to keep our line management structure as shallow as possible, and for teams to directly own decision making relevant to their work.

Senior Engineering Managers are accountable for the technical and delivery outcomes for their area - that means supporting and developing best in class engineering talent, as well as creating an inclusive team environment for people to do their best work. You’ll be responsible for structuring, organising, supporting and challenging your team to deliver on their mission.

You can read more on the expectations of Senior Engineering Managers in our Progression Framework.

Is this role right for you?

While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and has worked as a software engineer in previous roles.

We recognise that Senior Engineering Managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who is adept at:

  • Delivery and Execution: Enjoys taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.
  • Engineering and Operational Excellence: Actively fosters a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key.
  • People Leadership: Has experience directly managing at least 2-3 Engineering Managers and leading orgs of around ~20 engineers. You can support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback.
  • Technical Influence: Partners with senior engineers to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.
  • Stakeholder Relationships: Builds strong stakeholder relationships with other teams, and creates a focus space for engineers to do their best work.
  • Organisational Wide Impact: Collaborates with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.

We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.

How we work 💻:

Locations & Flexible Working :

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

The interview process:

After an initial informal recruiter call you go through two main stages

  1. Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our Senior Engineering Managers or Engineering Directors. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)
  2. Loop Stage (3 hours 30 mins) The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability) and one 30 minute reverse interview (more details below).

The Loop is one stage and the interviews in this stage are:

- Team and Org Management (1 hour)
An example based interview with 1-2 of our engineering leaders. They’re interested to hear examples from your previous experience on the teams you’ve led, how you’ve shaped and partnered with product, and the impact you had.

- System Design (1 hour)
You'll partner with a Staff or Principal Engineer on a technical whiteboarding exercise.

- Behavioural (1 hour)
Similar to Team and Org Management, this is an example based interview with 1-2 Engineering Leaders. This interview focuses on your people leadership style and core behaviours as an Engineering Manager.

- Chat with an Engineering Leader (30 mins)
At Monzo, we believe interviews are a two-way street. This will be your opportunity to ask us any questions about Monzo, engineering leadership or our teams – whatever’s on your mind.

All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process.

What’s in it for you:

💰 £138,000 - £175,000 + Equity + Benefits

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here

#LI-Remote #LI-AL1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

data.title: Senior Developer, Fullstack - Platform Ecosystem
data.description:
About Fullscript

We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.

That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.

We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.

This is your invitation.

Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.

Join us and shape the future of care.

We’re looking for a senior fullstack developer to pioneer new domains, define the future of AI in healthcare, and take transformative product ideas from "what should we build?" to category-defining solutions people love using.

You’ll lead the charge across the full development lifecycle: understanding complex healthcare workflows, setting the bar for true AI integrations, shaping intuitive AI-driven user experiences, making critical architectural decisions, and shipping impactful products. We value engineers who pair technical depth with bold product intuition to turn ambiguity into industry-leading innovation.

We have a large team and a flat management structure. That means substantial autonomy—and an expectation that you’ll seek out context, exercise good judgment, and take responsibility for outcomes.

What you'll do

  • End-to-End Ownership: Own product initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.

  • Workflow Mastery: Understand users’ workflows well enough to challenge assumptions, uncover the underlying problem, and propose a practical solution.

  • Product UX & Polish: Shape intuitive user experiences, paying attention to both the overall workflow and the details that make a product feel polished.

  • Full-Stack Engineering: Build across the stack, including frontend interfaces, backend services, data models, and EHR integrations.

  • Pioneering AI Workflows & Development: Design, build, and scale state-of-the-art AI-driven workflows and integrations that redefine clinical practice, while leveraging modern AI-assisted development tooling to accelerate high-quality delivery with rigorous standards for security, precision, and maintainability.

  • Focused Execution: Turn complex problems into focused increments that deliver value quickly.

  • Pragmatic Tradeoffs: Make sound tradeoffs around scope, architecture, speed, and maintainability.

  • Cross-Team Alignment: Coordinate with teammates, resolve dependencies, and communicate decisions so work moves forward seamlessly.

  • Quality & Reliability: Build reliable, secure software with appropriate testing, monitoring, and operational practices.

  • Continuous Iteration: Stay close to what you ship, learn from how it’s used, and refine it.

What you'll bring

  • Proven Delivery: A track record of independently delivering substantial full-stack product work.

  • Technical Depth: Strong technical fundamentals and the ability to work confidently across frontend, backend, databases, and APIs.

  • Product Judgment: Ability to identify what matters, narrow the scope, and make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Standard for Usability: An eye for design and usability, with a high standard for the finished experience.

  • Maintainable Velocity: The ability to move quickly while keeping software understandable, maintainable, and reliable.

  • Communication & Autonomy: Clear communication, initiative, and the judgment to know when to act independently and when to bring others in.

  • Team Multiplier: The ability to make those around you more effective through thoughtful feedback, shared context, and reusable solutions.

Bonus if you have

  • EHR & Healthcare Domain Knowledge: A solid understanding of EHR systems, their APIs, and the challenges of integrating with healthcare workflows.
  • MCP & AI Integrations: Experience building or integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to connect AI tools with product data, services, and workflows.
  • Applied AI & Development Tooling: Hands-on experience building AI-powered product features and using AI-assisted development tools, with strong opinions about where they add value and how to validate output.

What we can offer you:

  • Generous PTO and competitive pay 
  • Fullscript’s RRSP match program for financial health 
  • Flexible benefits package and workplace wellness program
  • Training budget and company-wide learning initiatives 
  • Discount on Fullscript catalog of products 
  • Ability to work Wherever You Work Well*

*Our Wherever You Work Well philosophy means Fullscript teammates get to pick their own office — whether that’s in-office, at home, or a bit of both 🐶🏡

Compensation range

The salary range for this role is between $125,000 and $165,000 CAD. Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only. Additional incentives, perks, and benefits may be available as part of Fullscript’s total rewards package.

Final base salary depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.

Why Fullscript

Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.

What to Know Before You Apply

We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page.

A quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to phone or email inquiries about application status. If there’s a match, our team will reach out directly.

Fullscript is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available upon request at accommodations@fullscript.com.

All offers are contingent on successful background checks conducted in compliance with federal, state, and provincial laws.

We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada and the U.S.

data.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –  Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: 

  • TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
  • Fortune Change the World (2024)
  • CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
  • Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

About the Role: 

Maven is seeking a Manager, Payments & Reconciliation to lead the end-to-end financial operations and reconciliation framework across our enterprise and consumer programs. Reporting into the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) team, you will architect a robust, scalable payment integrity program. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of payment funding, from accurate invoicing and money movement oversight to complex account reconciliation, while partnering with Product/Engineering to build automated financial controls that ensure operational excellence at scale.

As a Manager, Payments & Reconciliation at Maven, you will:

  • Oversee the end-to-end movement of payment funds across Maven’s Enterprise and Consumer programs, ensuring transaction accuracy, timely disbursement, and integrity across the full funding pipeline, including fee-for-service claims payments.
  • Own client and payer invoicing for payment funding programs and the timely reconciliation of complex claims funding account transactions and balances, ensuring paid claims tie back to funding.
  • Monitor clinic, provider, and fee-for-service claims payments against contracted rates and timeliness standards, identifying overpayments, underpayments, and SLA gaps, and partnering with operations to resolve root causes and recover funds.
  • Manage Maven's floated benefit funding program, including tracking outstanding float balances, driving timely recoupment from clients and payers, and escalating aging exposure to Finance.
  • Lead cross-functional root cause analyses on financial discrepancies and drive continuous process improvements that prevent billing errors, optimize cash flow, and increase the accuracy and scalability of the payments and invoicing function.
  • Partner with Finance during the month-end close process, including supporting the preparation of detailed bank reconciliations, owning reporting deliverables and assisting with analyses around collections risk.
  • Act as the financial subject matter expert for Client Success, equipping CSMs with detailed reconciliation insights and structural solutions to resolve billing disputes and optimize the client funding experience.
  • Act as the business owner for funding tools, collaborating with Product and Engineering to design application enhancements, resolve bugs, and automate financial workflows.
  • Establish and uphold strong internal controls and accountability standards to support audit readiness and financial compliance.

We’re looking for you to bring:

  • 6+ years in revenue cycle management, financial analysis, or payment operations, with direct experience in payment funding, fee for service, settlements, reconciliation, claims funding accounts or healthcare payment operations strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated readiness to lead a team, with experience mentoring junior staff, managing cross-functional workstreams, or standing in for a manager.
  • Extensive experience in account reconciliation and using AI (e.g. Claude) and data tools (e.g., Looker) to identify financial patterns and drive business decisions.
  • A proven track record of "creating order from chaos" by building sophisticated financial processes in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments.
  • Strong technical aptitude and experience partnering with Product/Engineering to resolve bugs and build automated financial fail-safes.
  • Proficiency in Asana, Jira, SQL, and Looker to manage financial workflows, track technical tasks, and report on program health.

The base salary range for this role is $115,000 - $130,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.

Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. This role is open to candidates in remote locations with a strong preference for San Francisco, CA; secondary locations include Seattle, WA and New York, NY.

Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week  (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend quarterly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

Benefits That Work For You

Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

  • Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.
  • Whole-self care through wellness partnerships
  • Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days 
  • 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)
  • Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens

These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.

data.description:
Headquarters: Remote, Poland

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer, Trusted Agentic Development, based in Poland, you'll build backend systems that help GitLab engineers trust the software they create with artificial intelligence agents. Agents can generate code and tests in seconds, but passing tests don't always mean the software works as intended. You'll contribute to validation approaches and feedback mechanisms that help agents catch that gap and self-correct while they work.

This isn't a quality assurance or test automation role. We’re looking for someone who has built with agents, run into the gap between passing tests and working software, and wants to help close it.

What you’ll do

  • Own backend features from design through production rollout, making the design calls within the architecture the team agrees on.
  • Build agentic code-review and validation workflows that check whether generated code does what was intended, not just whether its tests pass.
  • Prototype focused validation and feedback mechanisms with your teammates, and use what you learn to improve the platform.
  • Develop language-aware validation approaches, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, adapting techniques to each language while applying a shared definition of trusted software to assess whether agent-generated code delivers the intended behavior.
  • Implement feedback that helps agents identify problems and self-correct during development.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to test these approaches in real workflows, measure adoption, engineer trust, and validation quality, and use those measurements to evaluate improvements.
  • Participate in code and design reviews, explain implementation trade-offs, and seek feedback on your work.
  • Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it.

What you’ll bring

  • Hands-on experience building software with artificial intelligence agents and understanding why their output can pass tests yet fail to behave as intended, from encountering that gap yourself or building something to prevent it.
  • Backend development experience in at least one of Rust, Ruby, Go, or Python, with openness to working across languages.
  • Experience taking backend features from design into production, discussing implementation trade-offs, and knowing when to ask for guidance.
  • Comfort working inside a large existing codebase, not only on greenfield projects.
  • A practical approach to prototyping, learning from results, and turning useful ideas into working software.
  • Clear written communication and the ability to collaborate in an all-remote, asynchronous environment.
  • The ability to share decisions transparently and improve your work through iteration and feedback.
  • Familiarity with containerized services; Kubernetes experience is a plus.

About the team

The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our engineers rely on every day. We work across engineering teams and programming languages to understand how people use agents, test new approaches in real workflows, and create a shared model of trusted agentic development that teams choose to adopt.

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team: 

Unsecured Installments is one of Upstart's core lending products, helping borrowers access credit through a seamless, digitally native experience. The team owns critical parts of the borrower journey across offer generation, pricing, underwriting, funding, and borrower experience, while working closely with the broader lending platform that powers Upstart at scale. Recent work has focused on improving borrower flows, repricing and rate flexibility, partnership experiences, and the overall quality of the customer-facing experience.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Unsecured Installments team, you'll be a technical leader for the frontend and full-stack experiences that borrowers interact with directly. Working primarily in React and TypeScript, you'll own the delivery of large, multi-month projects, shape the architecture of the team's mobile-web and full-stack surfaces, and set a high bar for quality across the borrower experience. You'll partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to turn ambiguous problems into durable, well-architected solutions, and you'll mentor other engineers along the way.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Own the design and delivery of large, complex frontend initiatives using React and TypeScript, from planning and sequencing through launch and long-term maintenance.

  • Set technical direction for the team's frontend architecture, owning a 3–6 month roadmap and proactively addressing systemic gaps that threaten team effectiveness.

  • Raise the bar for engineering excellence through strong component and API design, thoughtful state management, testing, observability, and operational rigor across borrower-facing surfaces.

  • Lead through ambiguity, breaking down loosely defined problems into clear, testable plans and using data to inform tradeoffs on scope, performance, and user experience.

  • Mentor and grow other engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance, and serve as a trusted collaborator across the team.

  • Contribute to how the team uses AI in development workflows and product capabilities, with a pragmatic view of where it can create meaningful leverage.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) and 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Deep proficiency building complex web applications with React and TypeScript, including component architecture, state management, performance optimization, and consuming REST or GraphQL APIs.

  • Track record of independently leading the design and delivery of large, business-critical frontend projects in production.

  • Ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments where product requirements, constraints, and system boundaries evolve over time.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and align product, design, and engineering partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building consumer-facing products at scale with strong attention to performance, accessibility, and user experience.

  • Background in fintech, lending, payments, or other regulated financial products with complex user journeys and high quality expectations.

  • Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, or feature-flagging to drive iterative product improvements in production.

  • Familiarity with modern frontend tooling and testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress) and CI/CD workflows.

  • Hands-on experience leveraging generative AI in product features or internal engineering workflows.

  • Passion for building products that expand access to credit and improve financial outcomes for consumers.

data.title: Backend Engineer (Ruby), Plan: Spec-Driven Development
data.description:
Headquarters: Remote, Poland

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Backend Engineer on the Plan: Spec-Driven Development team, you'll help build GitLab's intent-to-code loop: agentic workflows that turn a stated intent into a refined work item, an implementation plan, and verified, mergeable code. You'll own early-stage backend work across the flows, application programming interfaces, data models, and evaluation systems behind this experience, using Ruby on Rails, Python, PostgreSQL, GitLab Duo Agent Platform, large language model application programming interfaces, and an artificial intelligence gateway.

You'll join a small, distributed team working on one of GitLab's highest-visibility product bets, collaborating with design partners toward a public beta. In your first year, you'll lead major features from an unclear problem through release, help shape scope with product and users, mentor other engineers, and influence technical decisions across agent workflows and evaluation methods.

What you’ll do

  • Lead backend features from early product discussions through technical design, implementation, rollout, and post-launch learning.
  • Build the flows, application programming interfaces, and data models behind agent-generated work items, implementation plans, durable specifications, and mergeable code.
  • Develop evaluation and benchmarking systems that measure workflow quality, token cost, and success rate.
  • Use Ruby on Rails and Python to build reliable production systems, with PostgreSQL, GraphQL, representational state transfer, GitLab Duo Agent Platform, large language model application programming interfaces, and an artificial intelligence gateway.
  • Collaborate directly with product, design, engineers, design partners, and users to shape scope and make practical trade-offs.
  • Coordinate multi-person projects across the team and communicate decisions clearly in GitLab's asynchronous, all-remote environment.
  • Mentor other engineers and contribute to technical direction across the Plan group and related artificial intelligence initiatives.
  • Work in short iterations, share progress through demos, and use results and user feedback to guide what comes next.
  • Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you’ll bring

  • Strong Ruby on Rails experience in a large production codebase and production experience with Python.
  • Experience driving substantial projects with several engineers over multiple months, with clear user or business outcomes.
  • A product mindset and experience owning features end to end, including shaping scope, making trade-offs, engaging with users, and learning from adoption after launch.
  • A full stack background with a current focus on backend engineering, plus the ability to read modern frontend code and design effective APIs.
  • Strong application programming interface design and structured query language fundamentals.
  • Experience exploring artificial intelligence-assisted development.
  • The ability to work independently, collaborate across functions and regions, and support others through technical leadership and mentoring. Experience with GraphQL, PostgreSQL performance at scale, or building and evaluating large language model or agent systems is helpful but not required.

We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and transferable experience. If you're excited about the role but don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

About the team

We are a team of four engineers, with two backend and two frontend engineers across Canada and Europe. You'll work in an all-remote, async-first environment with weekly sync calls, retrospectives, demos, and short iterations. This is early-stage work with broad ownership, space for creativity, and a fast pace. For more about our team and its work, see Plan Team Handbook Page and Spec-Driven Development Initiative

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the EU, applicable in the specified country or countries only. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location and having regard to any applicable collective agreements. The base salary range does not include bonuses, equity, or benefits.

Poland base salary range: 272,000 - 408,000 PLN

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave 

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

data.title: AI Augmented Fullstack | Remote in Mexico
data.description:
Important IT company At the Latin American level, growth requires:

AI Augmented Fullstack

Role overview

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to build and maintain a multi-service application using C#, Core, React, TypeScript, and Azure. The role includes integration with the planned DataFusion backend platform using PostgreSQL, Delta Lake tables, and Databricks. The developer will own implementation, integration, reliability, security, and production support.

The developer will use AI coding assistants to accelerate delivery while validating generated code and ensuring independently developed services work together consistently.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and develop REST APIs and background workers using C# and Core.

  • Build React interfaces and integrate micro frontends with clear shell and remote boundaries.

  • Implement asynchronous communication using Azure Service Bus queues, topics, and subscriptions.

  • Define API and event contracts, including versioning and backward compatibility.

  • Develop and optimize PostgreSQL queries, stored procedures, and functions where appropriate; manage indexing, transactions, schema migrations, and database performance.

  • Integrate APIs and services with the planned DataFusion backend platform through defined interfaces and data contracts, using PostgreSQL and Delta Lake tables according to workload requirements.

  • Develop, integrate, and troubleshoot Databricks data workflows using SQL and Python/PySpark as appropriate, including ingestion, transformation, Delta table updates, data validation, and job monitoring.

  • Review and improve AI-generated code for correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.

  • Write appropriate units, integration, contracts, and end-to-end tests.

  • Implement authentication, authorization, structured logging, tracing, and monitoring.

  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines, support releases, investigate incidents, and document architecture decisions.

Required technical skills

  • Years of experience: 8+ years of professional C#/.NET development, with hands-on delivery of production applications. Working experience with React, Databricks, PostgreSQL, and Delta Lake is required.

  • Backend development: C#, Core, REST APIs, dependency injection, async/await, cancellation, background services, validation, and consistent API error handling.

  • Frontend development: React, TypeScript, hooks, routing, state management, HTML, CSS, accessibility, and browser debugging.

  • Micro frontends: Module Federation or equivalent integration approach; shared dependencies, routing, authentication integration, CSS isolation, and independent deployments.

  • Messaging and distributed systems: Azure Service Bus settlement, message locks, retries, dead-letter queues, duplicate delivery, ordering, eventual consistency, service boundaries, and failure recovery.

  • Data and security: PostgreSQL, SQL, EF Core with Npgsql, transactions, indexing, migrations, concurrency, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, authorization, managed identities, and secrets management. Understanding transactional PostgreSQL and analytical Delta Lake workloads is required.

  • Databricks and Delta Lake: Hands-on working experience with Databricks notebooks, SQL, jobs/workflows, and Python/PySpark for relevant data tasks. Experience with Delta tables, schema enforcement and evolution, MERGE/upserts, incremental processing, data quality, and performance troubleshooting.

  • DataFusion backend integration: Ability to integrate .NET applications with the planned DataFusion platform, define API and data contracts, and work with PostgreSQL and Delta Lake-backed datasets through supported interfaces. Understanding data ownership, consistency, access controls, and operational failure handling.

  • Testing and delivery: xUnit or equivalent, React Testing Library, Git, Docker, CI/CD, Azure hosting, Application Insights, and distributed tracing.

  • AI application integration: Working understanding of agent workflows, tool/function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Ability to integrate AI capabilities with .NET APIs and business applications while applying output validation, access controls, and guardrails.

  • AI-assisted engineering: Proficiency with AI coding assistants and the ability to validate generated code and dependencies, maintain shared engineering instructions, and apply sound judgment to architecture, security, performance, and test coverage.

Good to have - Agentic AI experience

  • Agent frameworks: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, or an equivalent framework.

  • RAG and enterprise knowledge: Experience with document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector/hybrid search, grounding, citations, and enterprise knowledge bases.

  • Microsoft AI platform: Familiarity with Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Search, and related Azure AI and model services.

  • Agent integration and reliability: Experience integrating agents with .NET APIs, databases, tools, or MCP servers, with awareness of evaluation, guardrails, access controls, human approval, token usage, latency, and cost optimization.

ADVANCED CONVERSATIONAL ENGLISH AND SPANISH ESSENTIAL (Will be evaluated).

If you are a foreingner residing in Mexico, you must have a valid INE, CURP, NSS and RFC.

About the product:

Our company specializes in building cutting-edge Managed DNS infrastructure solutions that
ensure high availability, reliability, and security. We focus on delivering robust DNS services,
including authoritative DNS servers, DNS APIs, DNSSEC, and DNS failover mechanisms,
seamlessly integrated with our advanced Traffic Management System. Our goal is to provide
scalable and efficient DNS solutions that empower businesses to manage their traffic with ease

and confidence.

What You Will Do:

As a Software Engineer, you'll collaborate with a dynamic team focused on innovation and
excellence. Your role will be pivotal in developing and maintaining our Traffic Management
System, which steers client traffic for performance, availability, and resilience

About the role:

  • Design, build, and maintain the Traffic Management System API (a Go service) to manage routing and traffic-steering configuration across our global edge fleet.

  • Develop the agent that renders and applies routing configuration on edge nodes, reliably driving desired state from the API out to the edge.

  • Build and extend BGP and Anycast routing capabilities, including config rendering, peer-group and route-map support, and prefix filtering, as we consolidate edge routing onto a single control plane.

  • Develop and maintain automated failover and high-availability solutions, including non-stop maintenance mode and capacity- and health-aware traffic offloading from saturated points of presence.

  • Strengthen reliability through strong test coverage (config rendering and end-to-end pipeline tests), metrics, and observability across the routing pipeline.

data.title: Senior Security Engineer (Microsoft Purview)
data.description:
Own the controls that protect sensitive data across the enterprise, with a primary focus on Microsoft Purview.

As a Senior Security Engineer at Resmed, you will design, implement, and continuously improve data security controls, primarily across Microsoft 365. Your work will strengthen how sensitive information is classified, shared, retained, monitored, and protected, helping Resmed meet business, privacy, audit, and regulatory requirements. You will bring hands-on expertise in Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Information Protection, and data loss prevention, while working hands-on with security controls and collaborating with teams responsible for the Microsoft 365 platform.

This is a highly collaborative role within a global enterprise security team. You will work across IT, Legal, Risk, Security Operations, and platform teams to translate business and security requirements into practical, sustainable controls and progress agreed Data Security initiatives that protect data throughout its lifecycle.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, engineer, configure, and maintain Microsoft Purview controls, working with platform owners where required, including Microsoft Information Protection, sensitivity labels, rights management, encryption, retention, and information governance policies.
  • Implement, test, and tune DLP controls to reduce unauthorized data sharing.
  • Contribute to engineering and implementation activities involving broader Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) controls, including identifying sensitive data exposure risks and implementing appropriate protection measures.
  • Assess Microsoft 365 security baselines and recommend improvements across enterprise collaboration services.
  • Manage and validate external sharing, guest access, and third-party collaboration controls.
  • Monitor compliance posture, investigate trends, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Support audits and regulatory reviews by gathering evidence, maintaining documentation, and producing accurate reports.
  • Engage with IT, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Security Operations, and platform teams to understand requirements, provide technical guidance, and implement effective data protection controls.
  • Support delivery of assigned Enterprise Security Data Security initiatives under the direction of Security leadership, coordinating stakeholders and completing hands-on engineering deliverables.
  • Translate stakeholder and business requirements into technical security requirements, working with relevant teams to agree practical implementation approaches.
  • Participate in incident response, investigations, and post-incident reviews involving information protection and data exposure.
  • Automate policy deployment, reporting, and repeatable security processes using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API where appropriate.
  • Integrate relevant Microsoft 365 security signals with SIEM capabilities for monitoring and incident correlation.
  • Stay current with Microsoft 365 security and compliance developments, emerging threats, and evolving data protection standards.

What You Bring

  • At least three to five years of hands-on security engineering experience in enterprise environments, with a strong focus on Microsoft 365 information protection, DLP, or data governance.
  • Practical experience designing, implementing, and maintaining Microsoft Information Protection policies, sensitivity labels, rights management, and encryption controls.
  • Experience developing, implementing, and refining DLP policies across Microsoft 365 collaboration services and endpoints, with exposure to broader DLP controls desirable.
  • Working knowledge of Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) concepts and capabilities, including sensitive data discovery, exposure risk identification, and remediation.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Purview capabilities, including Data Lifecycle Management, Insider Risk Management, eDiscovery, Audit, and Information Governance.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Entra governance and conditional access integrations.
  • Experience working with Generative AI technologies, with an understanding of associated Data Security risks, including sensitive data exposure, unauthorized data sharing, and shadow AI.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex security control issues and working with platform owners or technology vendors to resolve implementation challenges.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with business and technical stakeholders, communicate technical recommendations, and progress assigned security engineering initiatives.
  • Experience managing external sharing, guest access, and third-party data access controls.
  • Ability to align technical controls with relevant frameworks and regulations, including ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, GDPR, HIPAA, CIS, and the Australian Privacy Act.
  • Experience supporting compliance operations, incident management, or data governance in a regulated or high-assurance environment.
  • SC-401 certification and a bachelor’s degree are preferred.

Nice to have:

  • SC-200 or SC-900 certification.
  • CISSP, CCSP, or Security+ certification.

What Sets You Apart

  • Analytical judgment: You turn complex business and compliance requirements into clear, workable security controls.
  • Constructive courage: You challenge ineffective approaches, explain the risk, and make a well-supported case for change.
  • Collaborative influence: You build alignment across technical and non-technical teams without losing sight of security outcomes.
  • Clear communication: You make complex data protection topics understandable and document decisions with care.
  • Continuous improvement: You look for practical ways to strengthen policies, automate repeatable work, and improve the compliance posture.
  • Global mindset: You collaborate effectively across regions and time zones while respecting different perspectives and operating needs.

Location: Halifax, Nova Scotia

Why Join Resmed

At Resmed, security helps protect the information, systems, and collaboration that support our mission to help people breathe better and live healthier, longer lives. This role gives you the opportunity to shape data protection across a global Microsoft 365 environment, contribute specialist expertise in a rapidly evolving area, and work with teams across the business to turn strong security principles into meaningful, practical outcomes.

data.description:
Your success is a train ride away!

As we move America’s workforce toward the future, Amtrak connects businesses and communities across the country. We employ more than 20,000 diverse, energetic professionals in a variety of career fields throughout the United States. The safety of our passengers, our employees, the public and our operating environment is our priority, and the success of our railroad is due to our employees.

Are you ready to join our team?

Our values of ‘Do the Right Thing, Excel Together and Put Customers First’ are at the heart of what matters most to us, and our Core Capabilities, ‘Building Trust, Accountability, Effective Communication, Customer Focus, and Proactive Safety & Security’ are what every employee needs to know and do to be most impactful at Amtrak. By living the Amtrak values, focusing on our capabilities, and actively embracing and fostering diverse ideas, backgrounds, and perspectives, together we will honor our past and make Amtrak a company of the future.

Job Summary

The Sr. Director Architecture - Train Operations is responsible for providing visionary senior architecture leadership to ensure technology investments are in alignment with corporate goals and its ability to move towards the future in an evolving business environment. As a Digital Technology senior leader, this role will utilize communication, guidance, and governance processes to maximize return on technology investment, and reduce time to capability, while minimizing operational costs. The Sr. Director Architecture will use visionary strategic thinking to choose technology capabilities, strategize and build around them to solve corporate problems.

As part of the DT management team the senior director will be responsible for communicating train operations technology target state, roadmap and change progress to senior leadership and other stakeholders. They will also use their communication and influence skills to promote awareness and understanding of architecture principles across the organization, evangelizing for strategic enterprise change, executing strategy, technical senior leadership.

As a senior people leader they will provide direction and development of leaders and teams to move architecture and business objectives forward.

Essential Functions

  • Set up and provide senior leadership steering for the architectural vision for core enterprise capabilities and aligning patterns to allow for consistency and reuse
  • Govern and direct enterprise principles, patterns and guidance that help in technology infrastructure, how applications are built, deployed, and maintained to align with strategic needs and maximizing technology investments
  • Provide Oversight and Governance to the current, interim and potential future state of key architecture domains value aligned with the organization's overall goals and objectives.
  • Ensure the reference architectures, standards, and guidelines of the organization's technology is safe, secure, stable and compliant with industry standards.
  • Direct enterprise-wide, transformational leadership to drive adoption and re-use of the preferred resources, processes and technology across the company.
  • Champion organizational design, enterprise strategy, innovation leadership for the architecture practice
  • Lead and mentor a team of architects, providing guidance and fostering a culture of excellence.
  • Create and provide senior leadership steering of strategic roadmaps and comprehensive plans that outline how the Digital Technology architecture will evolve to support the business strategy over time and ensure DT initiatives are prioritized based on their expected business value and strategic importance.
  • Guide Investment Decisions Aligning technology plans and investments to business vision and strategy that is necessary to ensure we are building the right things.
  • Provide senior leadership steering in the design, governance, and oversight for implementing robust, scalable, and efficient architectural solutions for domain business problems.
  • Guide and govern the translation of complex technical ideas into digestible concepts for both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders. Act as a leadership liaison for architecture best practices between digital technology and business teams to ensure alignment and understanding.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data and intelligence or related field with 15+ year’s relevant architecture experience or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience creating significant business value realization with $1B+ or more enterprises as an architect providing vision and choosing platforms moving organizations forward and scaled for expanding future initiatives.
  • 11+ years of relevant technical and business managerial experience with 2 to 3 years leading an Architecture Practice area.
  • Requires leadership experience in managing architecture teams and influencing executive level management and key stakeholders.
  • Requires demonstrated ability to manage multiple architecture engagement and effectively plan and use staff to ensure the architecture view.
  • Previous experience shaping enterprise architecture vision and leading an org-wide transformation and culture shift to that vision
  • Must possess strong communication and interpersonal skills, work well with others in an integrated team environment, and must be self-motivated.
  • Must possess a mastery of business acumen
  • Relationship building and collaboration skills across diverse and matrixed stakeholders and customers. 
  • Ability to surface, prioritize, and balance priorities across multiple stakeholders.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, including experience leveraging data to inform decision-making.
  • Passenger Rail Operations Architecture: Fellow-level expertise defining target-state architectures and capability roadmaps for large-scale, mission-critical day-of-train operations across passenger rail networks.
  • Crew, Yard, and Consist Management: Deep domain knowledge designing integrated capabilities for crew planning and assignment, yard operations, equipment and consist management, and operational readiness.
  • Unified Train Tracking and Predictive Intelligence: Experience architecting real-time train tracking and status platforms that combine operational data to deliver predictive ETA/ETD, disruption awareness, and actionable decision support.
  • Schedule Management and Service Recovery: Expertise in operational schedule management, real-time re-planning, conflict resolution, and service recovery across complex passenger rail environments.
  • Optimization, Simulation, and Decision Science: Proven ability to apply optimization, simulation, digital-twin, and advanced analytics capabilities to crew, yard, consist, schedule, and network operating decisions.
  • Train Movement and Dispatch: Strong architecture experience with train movement, dispatching, traffic management, route and resource conflict management, and safety-critical operational integrations.
  • Rail Ecosystem Integration: Experience establishing secure, resilient, standards-based data exchange and partner communications with host railroads, state sponsors, commuter agencies, and other operating partners.
  • Resilient Real-Time Platforms: Demonstrated expertise architecting highly available, scalable, observable, and cybersecure event-driven platforms spanning IT/OT systems, edge environments, control centers, and cloud services.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in business or related field
  • Travel and Transportation experience or relevant technology domain experience
  • Experience with governance, risk, regulatory and compliance.
  • The Architect’s skills and knowledge should span multiple architecture domains (e.g., Business Architecture, Application/Solution Architecture, Technical/Infrastructure Architecture & Information/Data Architecture)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent applied experience.
  • 15+ years’ experience in relevant industry experience
  • 11+ years in managing talent.
  • Experience managing teams.
  • Strong understanding of Architecture best practice and value methodology
  • Knowledge of IT, OT, domain and business architecture
  • Experience with Agile process for business value realization
