  • Leading one of the most strategic digital transformation initiatives across a global organization.
  • Partnering with business leaders, IT teams, and world-class system integrators to modernize enterprise systems that support thousands of associates worldwide.
  • Driving the implementation of Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and helping shape the future operating model of a company committed to safeguarding the world's most vital resources.

Join us before the end of 2026 and receive a $10,000 sign-on bonus! Candidates who are able to start by December 31, 2026, will be eligible for this additional incentive. We are also offering a 20% annual bonus for this role.

At Hach, you'll have the opportunity to lead complex, high-impact ERP transformation programs while working alongside talented teams passionate about innovation, continuous improvement, and delivering meaningful business outcomes. Hach is part of Veralto, a global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods.

In This Role, a Typical Day Will Look Like:

  • Leading large-scale Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementation and transformation projects from planning through go-live and stabilization.
  • Managing critical workstreams including data migration, system integrations, testing, cutover planning, risk management, and change management.
  • Partnering with business stakeholders, SMEs, IT teams, and system integrators to drive project execution and business value.
  • Facilitating Agile planning activities including release planning, sprint planning, backlog management, and project governance.
  • Driving issue resolution, decision-making, and risk mitigation across multiple cross-functional teams.
  • Ensuring successful execution of System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and deployment activities.
  • Providing executive-level project communication, status reporting, and stakeholder management.
  • Leveraging AI and automation technologies to improve delivery execution and business processes.
  • Supporting global standardization efforts and helping establish scalable enterprise solutions for the future.

The Essential Requirements of the Job Include:

  • 8+ years managing enterprise application implementations projects (Oracle, Salesforce, etc.)
  • 5+ years implementing and supporting Oracle Fusion applications.
  • Strong experience with integrations, data migration, and release management
  • SDLC expertise (Agile experience)
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills

It will be a plus:

  • Working knowledge of AI and Automation solutions (Generative AI, Agentic AI, RPA) and their application in Oracle environments is highly desirable
  • Experience with Kaizen process is a plus.
  • PMP or SAFe agile certification highly desired.

Why Join Hach?

This is a unique opportunity to join a business in the middle of a significant global ERP transformation and help shape the future of how Hach operates worldwide.

You'll work on highly visible programs, partner with leaders across the organization, and contribute directly to initiatives that improve operational excellence, business scalability, and customer outcomes.

Most importantly, you'll do it at a company whose products and technologies help protect one of the world's most vital resources — water.

When you join Hach, you join a team committed to innovation, continuous improvement, and making a meaningful impact every day.

data.description:
Overview Company Summary MasTec Professional Services, a subsidiary of MasTec, provides customer solutions through feasibility studies, design and engineering services, turnkey EPC delivery, surveys, constructability reviews, consulting studies and design-build services. The Senior Electrical Engineer will support commercial, industrial, renewable, and mission-critical projects, including data center electrical infrastructure and substation design. This role requires independent technical execution, collaboration across disciplines, and direct client/project engagement. Job Summary The Senior Electrical Engineer is responsible for leading portions of multi-discipline design projects related to power distribution, substation design, renewable energy systems, and mission-critical facilities such as data centers. This role includes performing engineering analyses, developing designs, PE-sealing construction documents, supporting construction, and mentoring junior staff while working under general supervision of project managers. ** OPEN TO REMOTE CANDIDATES ** Responsibilities Produce preliminary and final design drawings using computer aided drafting systems for: Power distribution systems – commercial, industrial, etc. Substations, switchgear Data center electrical infrastructure Renewable energy collection systems Perform engineering calculations such as: Load flow, short circuit, coordination, and voltage drop Equipment sizing and conductor selection Grounding, underground thermal ampacity, and cable pulling Apply and interpret applicable codes and standards (NEC, NESC, IEEE, ANSI, utility standards). Lead portions of project design efforts, coordinating with civil, structural, and mechanical disciplines. Ensure project engineering activities comply with company and contract requirements and support overall construction schedule. Perform field surveys and prepare accurate field sketches; record verifications, prepare documentation and construction prints. Issue PE-sealed drawings and reports and provide technical support for construction, including participation in construction planning, execution, quality control, and completion of the work. Maintain project records for assigned work, package records per contract requirements and facilitate turnover to the client’s representative. Responsible for ongoing communication and timely identification of issues and pending or actual changes to the work performed that may impact costs, schedule, contract or customer relationship. Review RFP’s, prepare fee estimates and proposals. Additional duties as assigned. Qualifications Preferred Qualifications Experience with substation design (e.g., one-line diagrams, protection schemes, grounding systems) Experience with data center design (tiered/redundant systems, backup generation, UPS systems) Experience reviewing construction drawings and supporting commissioning activities Physical Demands and Work Environment This job operates in both a professional office environment and field settings (including substations and active construction/data center sites). Standard office equipment is routinely used. The physical demands described here are representative of those required to successfully perform essential functions. This role is primarily sedentary but includes fieldwork requiring walking, climbing, and occasional lifting (up to 50 pounds). The Company reserves the right to revise or change the job duties as the need arises. Management reserves the right to change the description, duties, or work schedules to accommodate individuals with disabilities. Benefits available include Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability and Life insurance, a 401k plan and Employee Stock Purchase plan. MasTec is publicly traded (NYSE: MTZ). data.title: Engineering Manager, Infrastructure Software

experience_requirements.text: 3+ years experience

data.description:
Who We Are

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.
  • Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.
  • Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.
  • Build Great Teams: We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work.
  • Raise the Bar: We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.
  • Think Long-Term: We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.

About the Role

Lightning AI is seeking an Engineering Manager, Infrastructure Software to lead a team of engineers building the software systems that operate and manage our large-scale GPU and bare-metal infrastructure.

The Infrastructure Software Engineering team develops production services, APIs, and automation that support the full infrastructure lifecycle, from provisioning and bring-up through monitoring, maintenance, and decommissioning. These systems enable engineers and other services to manage thousands of servers, storage systems, and high-performance networks programmatically, improving reliability and reducing manual operations.

In this role, a key initial priority will be scaling the team through hiring, interviewing, and onboarding new engineers. You'll inherit a highly capable, self-sufficient team, allowing you to focus significant time on recruiting and integrating new talent while providing technical direction, supporting engineer development, and overseeing the delivery of infrastructure software. You'll work closely with engineers across all of Infrastructure Engineering, including Compute, Storage, Infrastructure Operations, Networking, Data Center Operations, and Managed Services.

This is a software-first engineering management role that combines technical leadership, people management, and cross-functional collaboration. We're looking for someone who can guide architectural decisions, develop engineers, and help the team deliver reliable software as our infrastructure grows.

This role may be fully remote within the U.S., or hybrid out of one of our office hubs (NYC, SF, Seattle, or London), with occasional team and company offsites. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

What You Will Do

Engineering Leadership & Team Development

  • Manage, mentor, and develop a distributed team of infrastructure software engineers, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development.
  • Establish clear priorities, ownership, and engineering practices that support effective collaboration and execution.
  • Provide technical guidance while enabling engineers to take ownership of projects and architectural decisions.
  • Foster a collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing, feedback, and continuous improvement.

Infrastructure Software & Technical Strategy

  • Lead the development of production services, APIs, and automation for managing GPU and bare-metal infrastructure throughout its lifecycle.
  • Define the team's technical roadmap and guide architectural decisions for infrastructure software and orchestration systems.
  • Drive improvements to infrastructure provisioning, validation, monitoring, and lifecycle management through scalable software solutions.
  • Establish standards for software quality, testing, deployment, and operational reliability.
  • Balance immediate infrastructure needs with longer-term investments in software architecture and maintainability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Compute, Storage, Networking, Infrastructure Operations, and Data Center Operations to translate infrastructure requirements into software solutions.
  • Collaborate with Managed Services to support integrations between underlying infrastructure systems and customer-facing Kubernetes and Slurm services.
  • Establish clear technical interfaces and ownership across teams to improve infrastructure operations and reduce manual work.
  • Communicate engineering priorities, project progress, and technical tradeoffs to stakeholders and leadership.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years experience managing software engineers, including hiring, mentoring, performance management, and career development.
  • Strong software engineering background building production backend services, APIs, or distributed systems.
  • Proficiency in Python, Go, or similar backend programming languages, with the ability to guide technical design and architectural decisions.
  • Experience leading infrastructure software, platform engineering, or automation projects.
  • Working knowledge of Linux, infrastructure automation, and production systems.
  • Experience setting technical priorities, delivering engineering projects, and collaborating across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with bare-metal provisioning, infrastructure orchestration, or hardware lifecycle management.
  • Experience with GPU infrastructure, GPU cloud platforms, or high-performance computing (HPC).
  • Familiarity with hardware management technologies such as PXE/iPXE, BMC, Redfish, or IPMI.
  • Experience designing infrastructure control planes or integrations across compute, networking, and storage systems.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Slurm, or similar orchestration platforms.
  • Experience working in a startup or growing engineering organization.

Compensation

We are committed to offering competitive compensation that reflects the value each team member brings to our mission. Final offers are based on factors such as experience, skills, geographic location, and role expectations. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package for eligible roles includes a discretionary bonus, a meaningful equity component, and comprehensive benefits.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is:

$205,000—$310,000 USD

Benefits and Perks

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and long-term success:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents.
  • Meaningful Equity: RSUs that give employees a stake in the company's long-term success.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) matching (U.S.) and pension contributions (U.K.).
  • Flexible Time Off: Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and floating holidays to support work-life balance.
  • Paid Parental & Family Leave: Paid leave to support you and your family through life's important moments.
  • Professional Development: Annual learning and development allowance to support your professional growth.
  • Wellness Benefits: Wellness and work-from-home stipends to support your physical and mental well-being.
  • Sabbatical Program: Four weeks of paid sabbatical leave after four years of service.
  • Flexible Work: Flexible schedules and a hybrid work model for our office-based teams.
  • In-Office Meals: Complimentary meals at our office hubs.

Benefits may vary by location, team, and role.

At Lightning AI, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and create better products. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We are dedicated to building a culture where everyone can thrive and contribute to their fullest potential.

data.title: Senior EPM Lead

experience_requirements.text: 8-10 years of experience in Oracle Enterprise Performance Management solutions and strong hands-on expertise in Oracle EPBCS and Essbase multidimensional modeling

data.description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Summary of Position

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Oracle EPM Developer with 8-10 years of experience in Oracle Enterprise Performance Management solutions and strong hands-on expertise in Oracle EPBCS and Essbase multidimensional modeling. The role will design, develop, enhance, support, and optimize enterprise planning applications that enable budgeting, forecasting, workforce planning, financial planning, scenario analysis, and management reporting.

The successful candidate will partner with Finance, FP&A, Accounting, and IT stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, high-performing Oracle EPM solutions while maintaining strong documentation, governance, audit readiness, and operational controls.

Oracle EPBCS Development and Support

  • Design, develop, configure, administer, and support Oracle EPBCS applications.
  • Build and maintain dimensions, metadata, forms, dashboards, Infolets, Smart Lists, Task Lists, substitution variables, data maps, and application security.
  • Develop and maintain Calculation Manager business rules, Groovy rules, member formulas, and validation logic.
  • Support planning solutions including financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, workforce planning, capital planning, driver-based planning, and long-range planning.
  • Provide production support during monthly, quarterly, and annual planning and forecasting cycles.
  • Support Oracle Cloud monthly updates, impact assessments, regression testing, migration, and production deployment activities.

Essbase Modeling and Performance

  • Design and maintain scalable Essbase multidimensional models for EPBCS applications.
  • Configure dense and sparse dimensions, alternate hierarchies, shared members, attribute dimensions, dynamic calculations, and aggregation strategies.
  • Design and support BSO, ASO, and Hybrid cube architectures based on planning and reporting requirements.
  • Optimize cube design, calculations, data blocks, aggregation, retrieval performance, and Smart View reporting performance.
  • Analyze and resolve issues related to calculations, data intersections, dimensionality, storage, and application performance.

Integration, Automation, and Administration

  • Design and support data and metadata integrations with Oracle ERP, HR systems, data warehouses, and other upstream and downstream platforms.
  • Configure and maintain Data Management and Data Exchange processes, mappings, load rules, validations, and reconciliation controls.
  • Automate administrative and operational processes using EPM Automate, REST APIs, Groovy, PowerShell, or shell scripting.
  • Manage application migrations, Lifecycle Management artifacts, release coordination, security provisioning, and environment administration.
  • Troubleshoot data loads, metadata, business rules, integrations, security, Smart View, and application performance issues.

Business Partnership and Governance

  • Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into functional and technical solution designs.
  • Partner with Finance and FP&A teams to improve planning, forecasting, reporting, and decision-support processes.
  • Prepare and maintain solution designs, technical documentation, runbooks, test evidence, and operating procedures.
  • Support user acceptance testing, training, knowledge transfer, release communications, and post-production validation.
  • Apply sound security, change management, SOX, audit, and governance practices across the EPM solution lifecycle.

Qualifications Expected for Position

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, or related discipline.
  • 8+ years of overall Oracle EPM experience, including hands-on development, implementation, enhancement, and production support.
  • 5+ years of strong hands-on experience with Oracle EPBCS or Oracle Planning in a cloud environment.
  • Strong Oracle Essbase modeling experience, including dimensional design, cube architecture, dense and sparse configuration, alternate hierarchies, attributes, shared members, calculations, and aggregation.
  • Hands-on experience with BSO, ASO, and Hybrid cubes, including performance tuning and optimization.
  • Strong experience with Calculation Manager, Groovy rules, Smart View, Data Management/Data Exchange, EPM Automate, REST APIs, Lifecycle Management, and security administration.
  • Strong understanding of FP&A processes, budgeting, forecasting, workforce planning, financial planning, and management reporting.
  • Experience delivering or supporting multiple end-to-end Oracle EPM implementations or major application enhancements.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

The base salary range for this position is $150,000 - $170,000. In addition to a base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and benefits (subject to eligibility requirements) listed here: Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. Total compensation is based on several factors including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable for all full-time positions.

We follow a Flexible Vacation Policy, intended for rest, relaxation, and personal time. All time off must be approved by your manager prior to use. You will also receive 80 hours of Paid Sick, Safe, and Caregiver Leave annually. This applies to full-time positions only. Why join Teladoc Health?

  • Teladoc Health is transforming how better health happens. Learn how when you join us in pursuit of our impactful mission.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, religion, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, membership in an employee organization, medical condition, family history, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, parental status, or pregnancy). Headquarters: Remote

Alloy is where you belong!

Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.

Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces, Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers, Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker, year after year.

Check out our investors and read more about us here.

About the team 

Solutions Architects play a major role in Alloy’s Technical Solutions organization and are paramount to deal success. The Solutions Architect is responsible for delivering the technical win for client accounts. You will handle the technical post-sales relationship, present product fit, propose technical architectures, demonstrate the product, anticipate concerns, and offer creative technical solutions to Alloy clients.

Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our employees onsite three days a week.

What you'll be doing

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you'll:

  • Act as the technical lead on Risk-Based Authentication client implementations, working closely with the Alloy Implementation Managers
  • Conduct technical and architectural overviews of client needs to propose Alloy product solutions
  • Work closely with Engineering to handle data ingestion for client implementations
  • Help to integrate Alloy's API into an app in code
  • Independently run and handle end to end testing to meet client needs
  • Act as a mentor and consultant to other Solutions Architects on the team in relation to client implementations
  • Support the development of regular client reporting, technical documentation and FAQs, and rule optimization suggestions
  • Be a part of a client production readiness and supporting production launches (these occasionally occur outside of 9a-5p hours)
  • Serve as liaison between Product & Engineering and Technical Solutions
  • Serve as a client advocate in driving the development of Alloy’s products and services internally

Who we're looking for

You are both highly technical and a skilled relationship builder. You are comfortable in front of a variety of audiences, from explaining Alloy’s best practices to a bank’s compliance team, or mapping an API flow on a whiteboard with their product teams. Alloy’s post-sales process is highly consultative and requires our team to be flexible, creative, and empathetic.

  • 4+ years experience implementing and supporting complex technical products with a strong desire to work in a post-sales, client-facing role.

  • Experience working with IAM, Authentication, and/or related software platform solutions 

  • Hands-on, passionate and creative problem solver with the ability to lead clients to success

  • Excellent communicator and presenter able to gain diverse audience confidence and buy-in

  • Ability to build a deep understanding of a client's needs and guide them to a technical solution

  • Proven success in problem-solving with and for enterprises with a variety of requirements and technical ability levels

  • Experience working with REST APIs

  • Experience of data manipulation and ETL processes

  • Preferred: 

    • Interest in learning and implementing Alloy’s other product offerings
    • Previous software development experience in one or more of the following areas: Python, SQL

data.title: Associate Manager, SOX and Internal Controls
data.description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.


About the team
The Finance Controls team helps management establish and maintain effective internal controls over financial reporting. We partner closely with control owners, Finance and Accounting leaders, Internal Audit, external auditors, Technology and Security teams, Legal, Compliance, and other cross-functional partners to strengthen the control environment and support reliable financial reporting.

As an Associate Manager, SOX & Internal Controls, you'll own a defined set of business processes within Coinbase's SOX and SOC 1 programs from end to end. Our Internal Controls team keeps Coinbase audit-ready by designing, documenting, and monitoring the controls that safeguard financial reporting across a fast-changing crypto platform. You'll bring a technology lens to controls work, mapping data flows from source systems to financial statements, evaluating automated control evidence, and driving remediation when gaps arise.

What you'll do:

  • Own assigned SOX business processes end to end, including process narratives, risk-and-control matrices, key systems, automated controls, and business process controls, keeping each area audit-ready through continuous documentation and design updates.
  • Partner with Technology, Engineering, Security Compliance, and Finance Analytics to scope IT general controls and IT application controls, map data flows, and evaluate the reliability of system-generated evidence.

experience_requirements.text: 2+ years of experience

data.description:
Headquarters: Remote - Canada

Location Requirement:
This role is open to candidates located in British Columbia or Ontario, Canada. At this time, we are only able to hire employees residing in these provinces.

This is Engineering at Lattice

Lattice’s Engineering team continuously works to better our product and our craft. We use a modern, cutting-edge tech stack and love experimenting with new technologies. We strive for maintainable, robust, and performant code. We’re highly collaborative and continuously iterative and work closely with designers and product managers. We prioritize not only great technical architecture but also an amazing product experience.

The Integrations team builds the product and platform capabilities that connect Lattice with the tools our customers rely on. The team has established Lattice’s first outbound integration pattern with Workday, launched an MCP Server now used by more than 100 customers, and is expanding into third-party productivity-data ingestion to power products including Auto Updates and Evidence-Based Reviews.

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to help this team scale its impact: bringing integrations to market, building reusable platform capabilities and playbooks, and creating the operating rigor that allows each new integration to ship more effectively than the last.

What You Will Bring to the Table

You have 2+ years of experience directly managing software engineers. In this capacity, you have been responsible for guiding and coaching the development of your direct reports, providing performance feedback, hiring, and fostering a diverse, collaborative, and inclusive team culture.

  • Experience leading integrations, API/developer platforms, ecosystems, or marketplace teams.
  • Proven record shipping and operating third-party integrations, managing partner dependencies and API reliability.
  • Strong people leadership, including coaching for growth and promotion and addressing sustained underperformance.
  • Builds clear operating mechanisms for prioritization, delivery, quality, and cross-functional decisions.
  • Effective cross-functional partner to Product, TPM, GTM, and external technical stakeholders; able to build alignment across complex discussions.
  • Connects technical strategy to organizational goals and delivers measurable outcomes.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communicator who adapts effectively for executives, technical teams, and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfortable owning ambiguous, high-autonomy work and driving it to completion.
  • Empathetic, employee-centered leader committed to helping team members do the best work of their careers.
  • Demonstrates Lattice’s values: Ship Shipmate Self, Clear Eyes, Own The Outcome, and What’s Next?
  • Preferred: experience with Node.js, React, Flow, GraphQL, Postgres, and AWS.

What You Will Do

  • Lead delivery of third-party integrations and platform capabilities from prioritization through launch and ongoing operation.
  • Create reusable playbooks, technical patterns, and processes that reduce the time and effort required to launch future integrations.
  • Mentor and coach engineers, promoting technical growth and aligning their development with team & company objectives.
  • Bring a relentless passion for continuous improvement for both engineering craft and processes.
  • You will ensure a delightful, reliable experience for Lattice customers around the globe, while simultaneously enabling a rapid pace of development.
  • You will work with your team, Product, and Design to build new customer-facing products, and improve upon existing ones.
  • You will represent your team to the larger org. Ensure they receive public recognition for their success and take ownership of their failures.

___

The estimated annual cash salary for this role is CAD $146,250 - CAD $195,000. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Lattice’s applicable plans.

Benefits: The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical insurance; Dental insurance; Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance; Natural Disaster Support Program; Wellness Apps; Paid Parental Leave, Paid Time off inclusive of holidays and sick time; Working Remotely Stipend; One time WFH Office Set-Up Stipend; Retirement Plan; Financial Planning; and Learning & Development Budget.

Additionally, Lattice leverages current market data to determine compensation, so posted compensation figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Lattice reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

experience_requirements.text: 3 years relevant work experience

data.description:
Headquarters: -REMOTE, USA-

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is a tech company with a human story to tell. We’re here to empower teams to manage projects, automate workflows, and rapidly build new secure solutions, using simple no-code tools. We’re revolutionaries – so for us changing the way the world works is all in a day’s work.

Smartsheet is looking for a Solutions Architect to drive quality, efficiency and customer satisfaction within our Professional Services’ business by leading customer conversations and assisting customers with developing, building, testing and deploying solutions that leverage Smartsheet, the Smartsheet API and integrations between Smartsheet and other products. The right candidate will have a passion for working with leading edge, web-based, and AI-powered technologies and a desire to deeply understand Smartsheet’s benefits, use cases, and business and technical elements.

As a Solutions Architect, you will work with Smartsheet customers and partners on engagements to convert business requirements into Smartsheet solutions. Within this role, you will be considered the Subject Matter Expert pertaining to advanced Smartsheet functionalities in order to propose solutions for use cases across different industries and business groups. The right candidate is a strong communicator, detail-oriented, and is motivated by both working independently and leading impactful customer conversations.

You will report to the Director, Solution Architect. This is a remote eligible position and you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is registered.

You Will:

  • Develop, build, test and deploy custom software solutions leveraging a wide array of Smartsheet product & third party APIs
  • Design and build AI-powered workflows and automations — leveraging LLMs, AI agents, and Smartsheet’s native AI capabilities — to solve customer problems that traditional configuration can’t
  • Leverage AI coding assistants such as Claude Code to accelerate custom development, prototyping, and solution delivery across customer engagements
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools and techniques and apply them to accelerate time-to-value for customers
  • Lead technical consulting engagements that require custom software development by leading design sessions, defining technical requirements, and validating solution architecture against product best practices
  • Design and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives
  • Partner directly with customer teams throughout an engagement, embedding deeply enough in their workflows to translate real-world pain points into working solutions quickly
  • Rapidly prototype and iterate on solutions in close collaboration with customers, refining scope and design based on hands-on feedback rather than waiting for formal review cycles
  • Own solutions end-to-end — from initial discovery through deployment, adoption, and ongoing refinement in production
  • Build reusable components, frameworks, and accelerators that can be extended and redeployed across future customer engagements
  • Serve as the Smartsheet subject matter expert (SME) on Smartsheet product capabilities and AI-powered extensibility scenarios that leverage the API
  • Manage all aspects of technical projects, including, but not limited to, the schedule, deliverables, deadlines and client relationships
  • Drive the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Smartsheet implementation
  • Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
  • Provide feedback to our Product & Platform Engineering teams that inform product improvements and identify feature gaps
  • Other duties as assigned

You Have:

  • 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and education
  • Working experience with two or more of our primary languages (.Net, NodeJS, Python, Java, Ruby)
  • Full-stack development skills, with the ability to independently design, build, and ship production-quality applications — not just configure existing tools
  • Familiarity with AI/LLM technologies and experience integrating them into applications via APIs
  • Working knowledge of prompt engineering and AI agent design patterns, with curiosity for applying AI to solve real business problems
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, with comfort integrating them into a daily engineering workflow
  • Willing to travel periodically (up to 15%) based on customer and business need
  • Strong communication skills (written, verbal, presentation), with the ability to explain technical subjects to non-technical end user personnel in large enterprises
  • Proven ability to drive projects from concept through completion with minimal guidance
  • Customer facing experience
  • Comfort operating with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast-changing environments where requirements evolve in real time
  • A strong bias toward ownership — treating customer problems as your own and staying engaged through to a successful outcome
  • Experience rapidly prototyping and iterating on solutions based on direct, hands-on customer feedback
  • Experience working with SaaS/IPaaS applications in an enterprise environment
  • Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
  • Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume best practices
  • Knowledge of data integration and experience integrating SaaS applications with different business systems (ETL, CRM, business analytics, reporting, etc.)
  • Bachelors in MIS, CIS, CS preferred but not required

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range

$127,500—$165,000 USD

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

data.title: Senior Manager, Technical Brand & Content
data.description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Airbnb’s mission is to create a world where people can Belong Anywhere. As we work to achieve that mission, our cross functional Tech Operations and Programs team helps enable Tech organizations to execute and deliver on high impact programs and initiatives. 

The Difference You Will Make:

You will decide what the engineering world knows about Airbnb.

  • Our engineers solve hard problems at scale across infrastructure, data, and applied AI — and they write about that work well. Almost none of the engineers we'd most like to hire have ever seen it.
  • You'll change that, and the change is measurable. A year in, senior candidates should arrive already able to describe our technical work accurately, because they found it before we found them. Our engineers should be recognised names in their fields rather than anonymous authors. Airbnb should be the source people cite on at least one technical domain. And the strongest engineers in the market should have a reason to choose us that has nothing to do with the offer.
  • That is a rare kind of impact for this discipline. Most tech brand roles are asked to manufacture credibility that isn't there. Here the engineering is genuinely strong and already documented — the gap is that it doesn't travel. You'd be building the function that closes it, with real autonomy, very little inherited process, and direct access to engineering leaders and our CTO.

A Typical Day:

  • Own the editorial engine. Run the Airbnb Tech Blog end to end: sourcing topics from teams, coaching engineer-authors, editing to a high bar, and moving posts through legal, security and comms review without letting them stall. Set and hold a publishing rhythm the org can rely on.
  • Find the cross-team narratives. Our biggest gap is that individually strong posts never add up to a story. You'll work across orgs to identify the themes that connect work from multiple teams, and publish them as connected sets — while each domain keeps publishing in depth for its own specialists.
  • Build our voices. Help our engineers and technical leaders develop genuine public presence: bylines, talks, speaker coaching, and a pipeline of new voices. This includes partnering closely with our CTO to establish his public technical presence.
  • Own distribution. Establish our canonical home on an Airbnb-owned domain, stand up the surfaces we're missing including video, and decide what our social channels are for. Publishing well and distributing poorly is the pattern we're here to break.
  • Run our external presence. Set conference and event strategy — where we speak, where we sponsor, where we skip — and manage what we host ourselves. Own our academic collaborations and technical media relationships, and the budget and vendors behind all of it.
  • Steward our open source presence. Make sure what Airbnb claims publicly is accurate and actually maintained, and that the projects carrying our name reflect how we want to be seen.
  • Prove it works. Partner with Talent Acquisition to connect this work to hiring outcomes — inbound share of the senior pipeline, offer acceptance at staff level and above in ML and infrastructure — and be honest about what is and isn't attributable.

Your Expertise:

  • Substantial experience in technical content, developer relations, engineering communications or technical editorial — including time spent working directly with engineers, not adjacent to them.
  • Technical fluency. You don't need to write production code, but you need to hold your own in a systems design conversation, read a design doc, and judge whether a draft post says anything real. Credibility with staff engineers is the difference between this role working and not working.
  • Editorial judgment and hands-on craft. You can edit an engineer's draft into something sharper without flattening their voice, and you know the difference between a post that teaches something and one that announces something.
  • Influence without authority. Nothing you need is owned by you. You've built systems and incentives that got busy senior people to produce, rather than relying on persistence.
  • Program discipline. You've owned events, budgets and vendors end to end, and you're comfortable with the unglamorous half of the job.
  • Measurement literacy. You connect brand work to funnel outcomes, and you're straight about the limits of attribution rather than reaching for impressions.
  • Judgment on risk. You've navigated legal and security review, and you know what shouldn't be published as well as what should.

Nice to have

  • Experience migrating a technical publication between platforms, including the SEO and redirect work.
  • Experience running or fixing an open source program.
  • Experience helping a senior executive build a public technical presence.
  • Familiarity with AI and ML engineering topics, and with academic or research communications.
  • Video or multi-format content experience.

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list  If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. 

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. 

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.  

Pay Range

$192,000—$237,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

data.description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

Job Title: Senior GTM Engineer

Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.

We’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.

Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, we’d love to meet you.

THE OPPORTUNITY
At Salesloft, our Senior GTM Engineer is pivotal to turning signals into pipelines. You will be the first dedicated GTM Engineer on the Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering team, reporting to the Director, Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering, with real ownership and a direct line to the people running the pipeline. 

We just brought two companies together and rebuilt our CRM and marketing stack, and now we need someone who builds. You will own the systems that connect our data (Salesforce, Snowflake, Databricks) to action (Salesloft Rhythm, Marketo, LeanData), turn buying signals into plays reps actually run, and put AI agents to work on the busywork that slows marketing, sales, and CS down.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for building and running the GTM systems that drive the pipeline. Specifically, you will:

  • Build and maintain integrations and workflows across Salesforce, Salesloft, Clari, Marketo, LeanData, ZoomInfo, 6sense, 1mind, and Tines.
  • Write SQL and Python against Snowflake and Databricks to build signal logic, scoring, and data products.
  • Turn usage, intent, job change, pipeline-trigger, and deal-health signals into Rhythm plays, and measure what they produce.
  • Build and run AI agents and automations with logging, guardrails, and a named owner for each one.
  • Keep data clean through deduplication, enrichment waterfalls, field governance, and routing hygiene.
  • Partner with Business Systems, Data & Analytics, and RevOps so what you build fits the platform instead of working around it.
  • Document everything, so that if you’re out for two weeks, the system keeps running.

HOW YOU’LL WORK HERE (our values, in this role)

  • Move as One: You’ll partner with Business Systems, Data & Analytics, and RevOps so what you build fits the platform instead of working around it.
  • Evidence over Ego: You’ll measure what your plays produce and retire the signals that don’t perform.
  • Lead from the Front: You’ll own the systems you build from launch through monitoring, with a named owner for each one, and document them so they keep running when you’re out.
  • Make Your Mark: As the first dedicated GTM Engineer on the team, you’ll shape how we turn signals into pipelines and help hire the next GTM Engineer.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
You’re a bias-towards-action, results-oriented builder who ships production systems, explains them to a sales leader in plain English, and stays laser-focused on the pipeline. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.

YOU’LL BRING 

  • 5+ years building in GTM systems (RevOps, marketing ops, sales ops, or GTM engineering), with production builds you can walk us through.
  • Strong SQL and working Python or JavaScript, and comfort with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON.
  • Hands-on Salesforce experience, plus at least two of: Marketo, LeanData, Salesloft or Outreach, 6sense, ZoomInfo, Snowflake.
  • Experience with a workflow or iPaaS tool such as Tines, Tray, Workato, or n8n.
  • You’ve shipped something with LLMs or agents that real people rely on every day.
  • You can explain a build to a sales leader in plain English and tie it to the pipeline.

IT’S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE

  • Experience with dbt, reverse ETL (Census, Hightouch), or Databricks.
  • Experience with Clay or ZoomInfo GTM Studio.
  • You’ve been through a merger or a CRM migration.
  • A background in marketing ops or RevOps before moving into engineering.

THE TEAM
You’ll be the first dedicated GTM Engineer on the Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering team, reporting to the Director, Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering. We just brought two companies together and rebuilt our CRM and marketing stack, so you’ll have real ownership and a direct line to the people running the pipeline. You’ll hear “Yes, let’s do that!” and then have the opportunity to execute on your ideas.

BENEFITS:

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a competitive, holistic benefits program designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health at every stage of your life and career. For full details on coverage options, wellness incentives, and perks, explore our benefits overview at  https://salesloftbenefits.com/

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

data.description:
Headquarters: Remote-US-CA

ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast.


We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to serve as a senior technical force multiplier across three pillars of our Platform Engineering organization: Integrations, Workflows & Orchestration, and Data Management. Together, these teams own the connectors, orchestration, and data quality capabilities that push ZoomInfo's data product into the systems our customers run every day.

This is a hands-on, high-impact individual contributor role. You will embed with whichever team needs the most help at a given time. That might mean a major initiative, a stubborn area of tech debt, a reliability problem, or a chance to grow into new territory. You will lead through influence, not authority. You will set technical direction, raise the engineering bar, and work with Managers, engineers, and Product to turn ambiguity into well-architected, shipped solutions.

You will report directly to the Senior Director of Software Engineering and work closely with three Engineering Leaders and their teams.

The Three Pillars You'll Support

  • Integrations: Native connectors and APIs that link ZoomInfo to CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, data warehouse, and BI platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Outreach, Snowflake, and others), processing millions of records daily.
  • Workflows & Orchestration: The engine behind lead-to-account matching and multi-step, event-driven business processes triggered by buying signals and business rules.
  • Data Management: Deduplication, standardization, enrichment, continuous verification, and GDPR/CCPA compliance that keep customer data clean, current, and trustworthy.

What You'll do:

  • Embed with Integrations, Workflows & Orchestration, and Data Management teams on a rotating basis, writing production-quality code and unblocking the hardest technical problems
  • Define and evolve scalable, fault-tolerant, event-driven architecture on Java/Spring Boot, Node.js/NestJS, Kafka, and workflow orchestration platforms such as Temporal or Google Cloud Workflows
  • Lead response and root-cause analysis for high-severity incidents and systemic reliability issues
  • Drive platform modernization by consolidating integration patterns, re-architecting legacy systems, and improving observability
  • Establish best practices for idempotency, retries, error handling, state management, API and webhook versioning, and workflow design
  • Shape multi-quarter roadmaps with the Senior Director, Engineering Managers, and Product, bringing technical feasibility, sizing, and risk into prioritization
  • Lead build-vs-buy evaluations and author architecture decision records and design docs that guide teams over multiple quarters
  • Mentor engineers at all levels and serve as a senior interviewer to raise the hiring bar

What you bring:

Must-Have

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in senior or staff-level roles, with a track record of technical leadership across multiple teams
  • Deep experience designing and operating backend distributed systems at scale, with strong proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and/or Node.js (NestJS)
  • Experience building or owning integrations or connectors with CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, or data warehouse platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Snowflake, or similar)
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority by aligning teams, driving decisions, and earning trust across engineering, product, and business stakeholders
  • Strong track record leading platform modernization, reliability, and observability initiatives, with excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to executive leadership

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures and streaming technologies such as Kafka, and workflow orchestration platforms such as Temporal, Google Cloud Workflows, or Airflow
  • Working knowledge of data quality practices: deduplication, standardization, enrichment, and GDPR/CCPA compliance
  • Experience with API strategy, webhooks, partner/ISV integration programs, and no-code/low-code workflow builders
  • Experience with multi-cloud environments (AWS, GCP), build-vs-buy evaluations, vendor management, and SaaS cost optimization

Role Summary

Cloud Data Store (CDS) owns the storage, retrieval, and lifecycle of all workflow data at planet scale. We design the persistence APIs, build storage abstractions that run across cloud vendors, and deliver the observability that lets customers trust their state machines for years. [to see more detail re: the Temporal CDS Eng team, click here]

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will get the chance to design, build, and maintain significant portions of our backend functionality for highly scalable, multi-tenant services. You’ll own the custom persistence stack for Temporal Cloud which includes a Write Ahead Log, various metadata stores (Cassandra, etcd), multi-level caches, tiered storage etc.

What You'll Do

  • Design & build distributed data systems – craft APIs, schemas, and replication paths that keep petabytes of workflow history durable and query-able. Clearly document design choices and operational knowledge to successfully deploy and run service with those features.

  • Drive reliability & performance – own SLOs, create chaos-test plans, profile hot paths, and lead incident reviews.

  • Technical leadership – break down roadmap epics, mentor mid-level engineers, steward design docs through RFC.

  • Cross-team collaboration – partner with the Server, Cloud, and DX teams to land features end-to-end.

What You'll Bring

data.title: Staff Tech Enablement Engineer, B2B Operations
data.description:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team:

As part of our B2B Operations, the Tech Enablement team serves as a central tech hub connecting Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, CX, and Operations. We focus on building internal tools and automations that streamline workflows and reduce manual work across teams. By unifying systems and data and leveraging a mix of low-code platforms and custom development, Tech Enablement drives efficiency and scalable growth for CookUnity’s B2B business. This small, cross-functional team wears many hats – from creating process automations and integrations, to building and maintaining smart hardware solutions – all in the service of empowering our Ops team and other departments to work smarter and faster.

The role:

  • We are looking for a Staff Tech Enablement Engineer to lead the technology that supports CookUnity's B2B operations and Smart Fridges program.
  • You will manage and develop a Tech Enablement Engineer, work hands-on with the engineer covering Smart Fridges hardware and OS, and collaborate with Product, Engineering, Operations, Healthcare, Sales, Marketing, and CX leaders.
  • You will own the direction and reliability of our internal tools, automations, and integrations while leading the hardware and operating-system work needed to deploy and support hundreds of Smart Fridges.
  • This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set priorities and technical standards, review architecture and code, investigate difficult software and device issues, and make sure each solution has a clear owner and support model.
  • You will help the team move quickly without creating fragile workflows, undocumented devices, or systems that cannot be operated safely at scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership & Prioritization: Manage, coach, and develop the Tech Enablement Engineer. Own intake, capacity, roadmap, delivery commitments, and communication with B2B and Product & Engineering leaders. Make tradeoffs visible and focus the team on measurable business impact.
  • Build & Optimize Automations: Lead the design, delivery, and operation of workflows that remove manual work across B2B. Use low-code tools such as n8n and custom software where each is appropriate. Ensure critical jobs have monitoring, failure handling, recovery paths, and clear ownership.
  • Full-Stack Internal Tools: Guide the development of internal web and mobile tools, dashboards, and services for Operations, Healthcare, CX, Sales, and Smart Fridges. Contribute directly to complex work, establish sound engineering practices, and decide when a prototype needs to become a supported product.
  • Hardware (IoT) & Smart Fridge OS: Own the technical direction for Smart Fridges hardware and embedded Linux software alongside the hardware engineer. Work across compute devices, locks, sensors, cameras, connectivity, and on-device computer vision. Partner with manufacturers and field teams on component choices, build quality, installation, device debugging, and failure analysis.
  • Fleet Scale & Reliability: Turn one-device-at-a-time setup and updates into repeatable imaging, enrollment, remote deployment, staged releases, rollback, and central fleet-health monitoring. Define release gates, security controls, and operational measures so hundreds of fridges can be deployed, updated, and supported without proportional growth in manual work or site visits.
  • Third-Party Integrations: Lead reliable data flows between CookUnity systems and platforms such as Salesforce, support tools, logistics services, and healthcare partners. Work with system owners on API and webhook contracts, data quality, credentials, and incident response.
  • Security & Operational Readiness: Partner with Security, Legal, Infrastructure, and Engineering on access, secrets, auditability, and reviews for customer and healthcare data. Build runbooks, alerting, and recovery procedures for business-critical workflows and field devices.
  • Documentation & Handover: Keep source-of-truth links, architecture decisions, device build and release procedures, deployment steps, and operational playbooks current. Decide with Product and Engineering which services Tech Enablement will maintain, which prototypes should be productized, and which should be retired.
  • AI Tools & Agents: Identify practical opportunities to use AI in B2B operations and engineering workflows. Evaluate prototypes for measurable value, reliability, data protection, and a sustainable owner before scaling them.

Minimum requirements:

  • Experience managing engineers, including coaching, feedback, prioritization, and accountability for delivery.
  • Strong hands-on software engineering experience across backend services, integrations, and internal applications, with proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript or Python and working knowledge of SQL.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating physical devices with embedded Linux or comparable IoT software in the field. You can diagnose problems across device hardware, sensors, connectivity, operating-system services, and cloud systems.
  • Demonstrated experience scaling a device fleet beyond hand-configured deployments, including reproducible provisioning, remote software updates, staged releases and rollback, telemetry, security, and field support.
  • Experience designing reliable production workflows using APIs, webhooks, scheduled jobs, and third-party systems, including retries, idempotency, monitoring, and data reconciliation.
  • Experience with cloud deployment, CI/CD, access management, and incident response for systems that business teams depend on.
  • Sound judgment about security and privacy, including when to involve specialist reviewers for sensitive customer or healthcare data.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous operational needs into priorities, technical plans, and clear decisions with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Helping to have higher levels of uptime & supporting the on-call rotation that will help the business run 24/7
  • Fluent English communication skills, written and spoken, for collaboration across teams and regions.

Preferred requirements:

  • Experience with Raspberry Pi or similar edge devices, and with AWS IoT Greengrass, SSM, MQTT, or comparable fleet-management tools.
  • Experience with camera pipelines, computer vision at the edge, hardware manufacturing, or device quality assurance.
  • Experience with n8n or similar automation platforms and with Salesforce or other CRM integrations.
  • Experience building internal applications with React/Next.js and Node.js or Python, and deploying them on cloud platforms.
  • Familiarity with healthcare operations or workflows involving PHI-sensitive data.
  • Experience with customer support, marketing, or logistics tools and their APIs.
  • Experience applying AI tools to operational workflows while checking output quality, privacy, and business impact.
  • Comfort leading a small team across software, hardware, vendors, and business stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.

Benefits:

💸 Get paid in USD.

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want.

⛱ Enjoy 15 business days of vacation each year from the start date.

🎄16 fully paid Argentinean holidays.

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider.

🗓️ 5-year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical.

🐣 Paid family leave.

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises.

🧘🏽‍♀️ Customize the benefits that suit your needs! Access a range of perks tailored to you, including learning opportunities, wellness memberships, delivery apps, and more through our comprehensive benefit platform.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach.

#LI-Hybrid

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

  • Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com
  • Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.
  • We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.
  • We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

data.title: Senior Product Builder - Talent Pool
data.description:
Headquarters: European Union - Remote

Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. 

About the Role:

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike is opening a new talent track for builders- senior engineers who take a feature from a rough idea to a production system on their own, and who use AI as a genuine multiplier rather than a buzzword. This isn’t a backfill for an existing seat. It’s a newly created role for someone who already operates autonomously and wants to keep doing that inside a company with real scale, real users, and daily production deployments. You take a high-level idea, figure out what actually needs to be built by talking to the right people, and ship it end-to-end: backend logic, frontend touches where needed, automated and manual testing, infra, and the dozen adjacent things a real feature needs. You read the existing codebase with judgment- reusing what’s solid, rebuilding what isn’t, and refusing to leave tech debt for the next person.

AI is not optional here. You’re expected to work AI-native: using it daily to move faster, and knowing when to push back when it suggests something that doesn’t hold up. If you’ve written your own automation, scripts, or internal tooling to remove friction from your own workflow, that’s exactly the instinct we’re hiring for.

Your Impact:

  • Take ambiguous, high-level product ideas and turn them into a concrete technical plan- by asking the right people the right questions, not waiting for a fully written spec
  • Designed, built, and shipped end-to-end features across the full stack- including a Java/Spring backend, REST APIs, data layer, testing, infrastructure touches, and rollout- while utilizing modern frontend technologies like TypeScript, React 19, Microfrontends, and Module Federation, alongside legacy Dart components.
  • Navigate a real, living codebase- deciding what to reuse, what to rebuild, and holding the line against unnecessary tech debt
  • Think in systems: anticipate second-order effects before they become incidents
  • Make technical and product tradeoff calls yourself, manage the risk, and push things over the finish line
  • Use AI tools (Cursor, Claude/Codex, our internal AI portal and MCP) as a daily part of how you build- including writing your own automations and skills where they save real time
  • Challenge AI output and product asks alike when they don’t hold up- critical thinking is part of the job, not a side skill

Your Qualifications:

  • Strong full-stack engineering experience, with deep comfort in Java (21), Spring, REST APIs, and SQL, TypeScript, React 19
  • A track record of owning features or systems end-to-end, not just executing a fully-specified ticket
  • Experience navigating and improving an existing, non-trivial codebase- this isn’t a greenfield role
  • Advanced, hands-on use of AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow- you’re past the learning curve already
  • Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the outcome, good or bad
  • Backgrounds we tend to see succeed here: technical founders, early engineers at startups who built the first version, small-company CTOs/Heads of Engineering, or senior engineers with active, recent open-source or side-project work

Our Stack:

  • Java (21), Spring, REST APIs, SQL
  • TypeScript, React 19, Redux, Dart
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ
  • Unit/integration testing, Java web stack
  • AI tooling: Cursor, Claude/Codex, Zencoder, internal AI portal, internal MCP

Interested in joining Wrike when the right opportunity opens up? Apply to our Senior Builder today. We’ll reach out as soon as a suitable role becomes available, or simply to arrange a Meet & Greet call.

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexander Chernev, Senior Recruiter.

#LI-AC1

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.
