We are seeking a motivated and scientifically rigorous Bioinformatics Scientist II to contribute to the development of next-generation minimal residual disease (MRD) laboratory-developed tests (LDTs). This role will support assay development efforts through bioinformatics analysis, experimental design, data interpretation, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams.

The ideal candidate is an early-career scientist with a strong foundation in genomics, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS). Candidates may be recent Ph.D. graduates or individuals with 1 to 3 years of postdoctoral or industry experience. The successful candidate will be a creative problem solver, critical thinker, and collaborative scientist who enjoys working at the interface of computational biology and laboratory assay development.

Key Responsibilities

Bioinformatics Analysis & Assay Development

  • Contribute to the design, development, evaluation, and optimization of NGS-based MRD assays.
  • Perform bioinformatics analyses to support assay development, analytical validation, and performance characterization studies.
  • Analyze and interpret complex genomic datasets and communicate findings to project teams.
  • Develop and maintain reproducible analysis workflows and scripts for assay development activities.
  • Support evaluation of assay performance metrics, including sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, reproducibility, and quality control metrics.
  • Participate in benchmarking studies to evaluate and compare bioinformatics methods and analytical approaches.

Experimental Design & Scientific Problem Solving

  • Collaborate with wet-lab scientists to design experiments, analyze results, and drive data-informed decisions.
  • Apply critical thinking and scientific reasoning to investigate assay performance, troubleshoot challenges, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Contribute to the development of novel computational approaches and analytical methods as needed.
  • Document analyses, methods, and study results in a clear and reproducible manner.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with assay development, molecular biology, software engineering, biostatistics, clinical, and quality teams to support program objectives.
  • Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, and project planning activities.
  • Help translate biological and technical questions into computational analyses and actionable recommendations.
  • Communicate results effectively to both computational and non-computational audiences.

Quality & Documentation

  • Follow established quality systems and development processes for regulated diagnostic assay development.
  • Contribute to study documentation, development reports, validation summaries, and technical records.
  • Support preparation of materials for regulatory submissions, audits, and design-control activities as appropriate.

Who You Are:

Required Qualifications

  • D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Biomedical Engineering, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Recent Ph.D. graduate and 2+ years of postdoctoral and/or industry experience or M.Sc and 5+ years of experience.
  • Strong understanding of molecular biology, genetics, and next-generation sequencing technologies.
  • Experience analyzing NGS data and developing computational workflows using Python and/or R.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently analyze complex datasets and draw scientifically sound conclusions.
  • Strong critical thinking, quantitative reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.
  • Demonstrated scientific curiosity, initiative, and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting development of NGS-based research or diagnostic assays.
  • Familiarity with cancer genomics, somatic variant analysis, and liquid biopsy applications.
  • Experience working with cell-free DNA (cfDNA) or circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) datasets.
  • Knowledge of bioinformatics best practices, reproducible research methods, and software version control tools.
  • Experience with cloud computing environments (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
  • Exposure to regulated product development environments, including CAP/CLIA, FDA, or IVD development processes.
  • Experience collaborating closely with both laboratory and computational scientists.

What Success Looks Like

  • Demonstrates strong scientific judgment and analytical rigor.
  • Develops a deep understanding of assay biology, experimental design, and data interpretation.
  • Contributes high-quality analyses that inform key development decisions.
  • Builds effective partnerships across wet-lab and computational teams.
  • Continuously learns new technologies, methods, and scientific domains.
  • Grows toward increasing technical ownership and leadership within assay development programs.

#LI-Hybrid, or #LI-Remote

For candidates based in our San Diego office, the range is $134,000 - $166,000.

For candidates based in our South San Francisco office, the range is $152,000 - $170,000.

For candidates working remote (US), the range is $122,000 - $158,000.

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

Pay range

$122,000—$170,000 USD

What We Can Offer You

Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose.

Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. Our Veracyte Diagnostics Platform delivers high-performing cancer tests that are fueled by broad genomic and clinical data, deep bioinformatic and AI capabilities, and a powerful evidence-generation engine, which ultimately drives durable reimbursement and guideline inclusion for our tests, along with new insights to support continued innovation and pipeline development. data.description:
SentiLink helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. We were also the first company to go live with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

Role:

SentiLink earns trust with prospects and customers (“partners”) by quantifying value with clear, data-backed business cases. The Solution Analytics team turns pilot datasets into rigorous retrospectives and ROI narratives that inform partner decisions and accelerate adoption. We also support existing partners with targeted, high-impact analyses that surface opportunities, de-risk implementations, and demonstrate ongoing value.

We’re looking for an analyst who blends business acumen with analytical rigor—someone who can frame ambiguous questions, structure analyses, and distill complex findings into executive-ready stories. You have a track record of translating data into decisions, building compelling presentations, and delivering them to senior stakeholders. Success in this role means owning the end-to-end analytics workflow (from scoping and methodology through insights and recommendations), communicating crisply, and influencing outcomes across Sales, Partner Success, Product, and Engineering.

This is a remote, US-based role.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct client discovery calls with account executives.

  • Meet with clients to discuss fraud strategies to mitigate risk.

  • Strategizing with the sales team to ensure alignment with partner’s needs.

  • Create and deliver presentations aligned to proposed solution value.

  • Support the sales team with all technical related queries.

  • Establish best practices across all solution analytics team members through effective coaching.

  • Design and execute analysis for white papers and other industry materials. Identity relevant insights, e.g., based on emerging fraud tactics, and collaborate on publishing

  • Develop relationships and maintain customer relationships.

Requirements:

  • 3-5 years work experience at a VC-backed startup, management consulting, banking or private equity firm with an analytical focus

  • Strong analytical & communication skills, comfortable with ambiguity, a quick learner, drives work independently

  • Enthusiastic about becoming an expert in topics related to the future of financial services, fraud & identity

Perks:

  • 401(k) plan with employer match (or equivalent for non US-based roles)

Corporate Values:

data.title: Senior AI Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. Leading companies and over 5,500 research sites rely on Inato to increase patient access, improve representation in trials, and deliver life-changing treatments to patients faster.

Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research.

Inato is a recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025 and 2026.

🧑‍💻 The Role

We are looking for a dedicated and creative AI Engineer to join our team. As an essential contributor to our mission of transforming healthcare, you'll play a leading role in building AI-driven solutions that directly influence clinical research and, ultimately, improve patient care. We’ve already deployed multiple AI use cases in production, and your skills will be crucial in pushing the boundaries of healthcare AI.

💊 Responsibilities

In this role, you'll take on complex challenges that will stretch your abilities and creativity:

  • Choose and orchestrate the right models to process and analyze multimodal data

  • Design and implement cutting-edge RAG techniques to efficiently handle large medical documents and patient histories

  • Build agentic systems to revolutionize key aspects of drug development such as patient recruitment or site selection

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (software engineers, product managers, data engineers) to seamlessly integrate AI into our platform

  • Implement robust and scalable pipelines that meet production-grade engineering standards

Here are some examples of projects you might work on:

  • Our prescreening tool: an app relying on the latest reasoning models and visual RAG to accelerate patient recruitment. It's already being used across hundreds of clinical sites to assess patient eligibility at scale. You may find more on this in our publication: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.15374

  • Our site selection agent: an agentic assistant coupled with a mathematical optimizer to assist pharmaceutical sponsors in their search for efficient clinical sites and find the right mix of sites for every study

💊 Qualifications

  • Several years of engineering experience with machine learning, data science, or AI at the centre of your work, not alongside it.

  • You’ve shipped LLM-based features (OpenAI, Anthropic, RAG setup, agent setup, LLM observability tools etc.) that real users use, and you’ve lived with them afterwards: fixed them when they broke, iterated when they underperformed, watched how people actually used them.

  • Python proficiency

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Strong communication skills, oral and written, both English and French

  • Strong product mindset able to challenge the product roadmap directly with our CPO

  • Knowledge about LLM’s evaluation challenges

  • Ability to autonomously deliver clean and production-ready code

🤩 Good fits we see often

  • ML engineers and data scientists who moved into LLM work as it matured.

  • Researchers who moved into production.

  • Software engineers who went deep on AI and stayed there.

😕 Probably not a fit

  • your AI work has been research, prototypes or POCs with nothing shipped and maintained in production.

  • you’ve spent most of your career in software engineering and shipped your first AI feature in the last year.

Why Inato?

Our mission is to make clinical trials more accessible and inclusive. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, bringing together industry veterans with fresh perspectives to advance the clinical trials industry.

Join us at Inato and be part of a team that’s making a real difference in healthcare.

💊 Benefits

  • Remote-first philosophy & flexible hours

  • Top-of-the-line equipment

  • Modern free health insurance (Benefiz)

  • Compensatory time off (RTT)

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile)

  • Gym membership (Gymlib)

  • Free books & learning material

data.title: Growth Analytics Engineer [España]
data.description:
En Product Hackers estamos construyendo el mejor equipo de Growth del mundo. Personas altamente creativas, inteligentes e ingeniosas pero con mente científica y absoluta obsesión por los productos digitales. Queremos ser el Space X del Growth, por eso buscamos a los mejores humanos, con las mejores capacidades para convertirlos en astronautas.

Si quieres sumergirte en el universo de los productos digitales, visitar los planetas de nuestros clientes (sus productos digitales) y terraformarlos para que puedan albergar vida (usuarios y clientes) este es el lugar ideal para pasar de ser un mísero humano a un astronauta del producto digital. Sí, también somos muy frikis del espacioX y esas cosas.

astronaut (2).gif

🚀 Además, en Product Hackers encontrarás un equipo que aprende y comparte constantemente, que busca que las ideas se experimenten, se prueben y se implementen sin miedo, porque aquí compartimos aprendizajes, crecemos juntos gracias a esta pasión por el Growth

Somos remote-first y contamos con grandes profesionales de diferentes puntos del mundo.

¿CUÁL ES TU MISIÓN?

Como Growth Analytics Engineer, tu misión será que el dato del que dependen las decisiones sea fiable: instrumentar bien desde el principio, auditar lo que ya existe y dejar la medición preparada para experimentar. Trabajarás sobre e-commerce y producto, y con equipos que necesitan leer resultados sin dudar de los números.

Aquí no vas a trabajar solo con herramientas de terceros: tenemos plataforma propia de experimentación y un entorno de agentes con MCPs que usamos a diario para auditar y analizar.

Y no te quedarás detrás del dato, serás quien lo explique al cliente, quien defienda qué merece medirse y quien haga visible el valor del trabajo ante sus equipos de negocio.

¿CUÁLES SERÁN TUS CONTRIBUCIONES?

  • Etiquetado de eventos en GTM para GA4 y otras herramientas de analítica.

  • Configuraciones avanzadas en GA4 para clientes.

  • Diseño de exploraciones en GA4 y de los cuadros de mando que las acompañan.

  • Creación de informes de resultados en Data Studio y Power BI.

  • Ejecución de auditoría de instrumentación para cada nuevo cliente.

  • Diseño y liderazgo de los planes de medición y de las taxonomías de eventos entre plataformas (web, app, servidor)

  • Referente técnico de instrumentación de experimentos para los equipos internos y los stakeholders de los proyectos en los que participa.

  • Implantación y revisión del consentimiento en la medición (Consent Mode v2, CMPs) y explicación de su efecto sobre los datos.

  • Instrumentación y validación de experimentos: que la variante quede registrada, que el reparto de muestra sea correcto y que no haya huecos de datos entre la herramienta de test y GA4.

  • Conciliación de datos entre la plataforma del cliente (e-commerce, CRM o backend) y GA4: detectar discrepancias en sesiones, conversiones e ingresos, encontrar la causa y proponer el arreglo.

  • Interlocución directa con los equipos del cliente (marketing, producto, negocio): presentar resultados, explicar discrepancias sin tecnicismos y acordar prioridades.

  • Gestión de inicio a fin de la parte de medición de tus proyectos: alcance, plazos, seguimiento y comunicación de avances.

  • Traducir los datos en recomendaciones accionables para el cliente, no solo en informes.

¿QUÉ TE HARÁ TRIUNFAR CON NOSOTROS?

Hard skills

  • Tener experiencia de +3 años:

    • Instrumentando productos digitales (e-commerce, lead generation o áreas privadas): dataLayer, eventos de funnel y de conversión, y validación de la calidad del dato.

  • Tener experiencia de 2 años en:

    • Entornos ágiles.

    • Creación de dashboards para clientes.

    • Gestión eficaz de tareas y proyectos complejos.

    • Jira, Trello, Asana o similar.

    • Trato directo con cliente: reuniones de seguimiento, presentación de resultados y gestión de expectativas.

  • Contar con altas habilidades de análisis en GA4

  • Tener capacidad avanzada de instrumentar con Google Tag Manager.

  • Ser capaz de crear dashboards avanzados en Data Studio y Power BI.

  • Iniciativa en documentación: dejar por escrito el plan de medición, las decisiones técnicas y los checklists de QA, de modo que otra persona pueda continuar tu trabajo sin preguntarte.

  • Experiencia con herramientas de experimentación (VWO, Optimizely o AB Tasty) por el lado del dato: etiquetado de variantes, control de muestra y lectura de resultados.

  • Consent Mode v2 y CMPs y su efecto real sobre el dato: modelado, huecos de atribución y tráfico sin asignar.

  • Uso de IA en el día a día de analítica: agentes y MCPs para auditar instrumentaciones, acelerar análisis y automatizar QA. No buscamos conocimiento teórico, buscamos que ya lo estés usando en tu trabajo.

  • SQL sobre BigQuery a nivel intermedio: agregaciones y JOIN, y manejo de la exportación de GA4 (estructuras anidadas, event_params, UNNEST), con control del coste de las consultas.

  • Inglés B2

Soft Skills

  • Adaptabilidad al cambio.

  • Carácter autodidacta.

  • Capacidad de trabajo en equipo.

  • Comunicación con cliente: explicar un problema técnico a alguien que no lo es, por escrito y en reunión, y que salga sabiendo qué pasa y qué se va a hacer.

  • Visibilidad del trabajo: mantener al cliente y al equipo al día sin que tengan que preguntar.

  • Manejo en entornos corporativos: varios interlocutores, procesos de aprobación y plazos largos.

  • Criterio técnico y capacidad de sostenerlo. Saber decir que una implementación no es fiable y explicar por qué con datos, aunque quien la propone sea el cliente.

ADEMÁS, SERÁ IDEAL SI TÚ...

  • Tienes conocimientos de:

    • HTML, CSS y JS.

    • Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch y Adobe Target (si no los conoces, te formamos: tenemos clientes en este stack). También Amplitude, Mixpanel, Quantum Metric y herramientas similares.

    • Python, R.

    • Etiquetado en servidor (GTM server side, Stape o similar).

    • Shopify: convivencia del contenedor de GTM con el custom pixel, limitaciones del checkout y conexión con CRM o email (Klaviyo o equivalentes).

  • Cuentas con experiencia en:

    • gestión de píxeles de tracking de servicios de ads.

    • Instrumentación de apps móviles: SDK de Firebase/GA4 para app, eventos y propiedades de usuario, y validación con DebugView.

TE OFRECEMOS

  • Full remoto + flexibilidad horaria amplia (con la limitación de los horarios de los clientes y reuniones de equipo) ⏰

  • Salario entre 28.000 - 36.000 €/brutos anuales (en función de expertise) 💰

  • Retribución flexible con Factorial 💸

  • Festivos de tu CCAA y locales ✌🏼

  • 25 días de descanso (22 días laborables de vacaciones + el día de tu cumpleaños, el 24 y el 31 de diciembre) 🎄

  • Jornada reducida en los meses de verano (julio y agosto) 🏖️

  • Acceso ilimitado a nuestra plataforma de formación PH School! Valorado en en +3000€/año 👨🏻‍💻

  • 500€ de presupuesto para adecuar tu puesto de trabajo en casa + ordenador de empresa (un Macbook Pro). 💻

  • Clases en pareja para mejorar tu inglés todas las semanas y conocer a tus compis 🇬🇧

  • Eventos de Product Hackers y teambuilding 🫂

  • Incentivo por traer nuevos compañeros Devs o GMs 🤑

  • Bonus de un porcentaje de lo facturado si nos traes a un cliente 💸

  • Plan de desarrollo y formación para que sigas creciendo como profesional de Product Hackers 🚀

  • Además de muchos otros más que están por venir porque nos gusta ampliar la lista siempre que podemos ❤️

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role


We are looking for a Senior Analyst - Analytics and Insights, FP&A to join our team. This is a Hybrid role based out of our Mohali Office, reporting to the Senior Manager - Analytics and Insights, FP&A in the FP&A department. In this role, you will build decision-grade analytics and forecasting capabilities by combining strong financial domain understanding with modern data and AI techniques. You will work hands-on in Snowflake, DBT, SQL, and Python to develop scalable datasets, automate planning and analysis workflows, and prototype Finance AI agents that accelerate insight generation with strong controls around accuracy and governance.


What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Partner with FP&A stakeholders to translate business questions into analytical requirements, deliver clear insight narratives, and drive measurable process improvements across planning and performance management
  • Model and analyze complex datasets in Snowflake using advanced SQL and Python to power recurring analysis, management reporting, and forecasting workflows
  • Build and maintain reliable ETL/ELT pipelines and transformation logic to ensure consistent data availability, freshness, and reconciliation across source systems and curated data layers
  • Develop and support diverse forecasting solutions—spanning driver- and rule-based models with scenario toggles and sensitivity analysis alongside machine learning approaches such as time series, regression, and classification with feature engineering and backtesting
  • Build and iterate Finance AI agents that automate repeatable workflows, including controlled variance explanation drafts, anomaly detection summaries, governed Q&A over finance definitions and model documentation, and automated data refresh validation and commentary

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You take full ownership of your work, pairing strategic vision with hands-on execution and unwavering integrity to deliver meaningful business outcomes.
  • You build high-trust partnerships across teams, elevating collective success and embracing candid, constructive feedback to drive clarity and alignment.
  • You are a pragmatic builder who thrives on creating, iterating, and shipping practical v1 solutions quickly while maintaining strong technical rigor.
  • You anchor decisions in rigorous data and empirical evidence rather than assumptions, uncovering the ground truth to guide smarter financial outcomes.
  • You design durable, scalable solutions and processes that connect daily analytical execution to long-term global growth.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 4–7 years of experience in FP&A analytics, finance BI, analytics engineering, or a related analytical role with strong hands-on execution
  • Expert proficiency in SQL (Snowflake) and strong working knowledge of Python for data analysis, workflow automation, and model prototyping
  • Hands-on experience with dbt (running and debugging models, extending transformations, adding tests, and maintaining documentation) alongside building or maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines with rigorous data validation and reconciliation
  • Practical experience with forecasting methodologies, including rule- and driver-based modeling as well as exposure to ML-based forecasting and backtesting concepts
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex analytical findings and model logic clearly for FP&A stakeholders

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience building AI agents or LLM-powered tools using frameworks such as Lang Chain or LlamaIndex, including prompt design, tool or function calling, and structured outputs
  • Familiarity with model evaluation concepts—such as quality checks, groundedness, and regression testing for prompts and agents—and safe rollout practices

Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $169 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual and learn more about how we work.

About the role

This role turns people data into the decisions that shape how Wealthsimple hires, grows, and keeps its people. You will build the models, the analysis, and the data products that show how talent moves through Wealthsimple, where it concentrates, who is at risk of leaving, and what the workforce looks like a year out. Reporting to the Director, People Analytics, you will own that work end to end, from the question through to the thing people actually use. Success looks like recurring people decisions getting made from what you built.

About the team

People Analytics sits within People and Communications. We are growing the people domain and want to get deeper into our data, through the models, data products, and analysis that leaders across the company use to make calls about talent. We are a small team, building like a startup inside the People team. Analytics developers own the data foundation, analysts handle day-to-day reporting, and software engineers build the products that put insights in front of managers. As our first data scientist, you will help set what best in class looks like for people analytics at Wealthsimple.

What you’ll do

  • Own the model building and the deeper analysis on people data, including attrition risk, workforce forecasting, and how talent moves and develops across the company.

  • Build people data products that leaders keep coming back to, working with our software engineers to put them in front of managers across Wealthsimple.

  • Move up and down the data stack as the question demands, from raw data through to the model and the surface it lands on.

  • Turn open questions from leaders and partners across the company into analysis they can act on, and be clear about what the data can and cannot support.

  • Bring statistical rigour to how we understand talent density and performance management, forming hypotheses and testing them so people decisions are data informed.

  • Set the analytical standard for the function and raise the level of craft around you, through how we test, document, and review our work.

Skills you bring

  • 5+ years in data science or a related quantitative role, owning ambiguous problems end to end.

  • Advanced SQL and Python, applied to work you have taken all the way to production rather than left in a notebook.

  • Applied statistics and causal inference. You can pick a method, defend it, and explain why a correlation is not enough for the decision in front of you.

  • Experience building and evaluating predictive models on messy operational data, including the judgment to say when a model is not the right answer.

  • Experience turning analysis into recommendations that senior leaders act on, including pushing back when the question itself is wrong. You lead with the outcome, then explain how you got there.

  • Comfort working close to the data layer, with modelled datasets, point-in-time history, and a cloud data platform such as Snowflake.

Nice to have

  • HR data literacy: employee lifecycle events, job hierarchies, headcount types, and compensation structures.

  • Workforce planning or headcount forecasting.

  • Experience with survey and engagement data.

  • Experience measuring people performance, such as review ratings, calibration outcomes, or goal attainment.

People analytics experience helps, but it is not required. If you have done this kind of work in product, marketing, growth, or customer analytics and you are curious about people data, we want to hear from you.

Who you are

  • You are energised by building, and you do not need a paved road to do good work.

  • You think about privacy the way a good engineer thinks about security, as a design constraint rather than an obstacle.

  • You would rather ship a useful answer and improve it than hold a perfect one back.

  • You are direct about uncertainty and say what you do not know before anyone asks.

  • You move between technical and non-technical conversations naturally.

  • You are pragmatic about AI tools and know where they speed you up and where they do not.

Why you’ll love this role

  • Ground-floor impact: Most of this work hasn’t been done yet, so you’ll shape how it gets done.

  • Visibility: Your work goes in front of leadership and shapes real decisions about talent.

  • Builders around you: Your models ship into products managers use, not slide decks

Why Wealthsimple?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year*

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year*

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

*Unlimited paid sick days, Wellness Days and the 90 day away program do not apply to certain roles.

ICYMI

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.

Inclusion Statement: We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. We strongly encourage applications from everyone, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Accessibility Statement: We're committed to an accessible hiring experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We also welcome any feedback on how we can better accommodate candidates with accessibility needs.

AI in Hiring: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but don't replace human judgment – all final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have questions about how your data is used, reach out to us.

data.description:
Overview

The Analytics Engineer builds and maintains the data assets that power Ferrellgas reporting, self-service analytics, and AI initiatives. This role supports development of the data transformation layer in Snowflake, helping turn raw source data into clean, business-ready data, builds and maintains Power BI semantic models, and automates the manual processes that slow the business down. The Analytics Engineer shares responsibility for the team’s data models and transformation code, providing coverage and continuity across the full data flow from raw data to business-ready data. The ideal candidate has strong data modeling fundamentals, hands-on SQL and Power BI expertise, and a builder’s mindset for replacing manual work with reliable, automated solutions.

At Ferrellgas our corporate roles are fully remote, enabling talented professionals to support our field operations from wherever they are. These positions play a critical role in driving business growth, providing strategic and operational support that empowers our teams in the field to deliver exceptional results.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Ferrellgas, we’re committed to supporting our team with benefits that promote health, financial security, and personal growth:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, vision, accident, and critical illness insurance
  • Income Protection: Company-provided short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D
  • Financial Wellness: 401(k) with company match, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), and Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Time Off & Family Support: Paid Time Off (PTO), parental leave, and tuition reimbursement
  • Wellness & Assistance Programs: Wellness program, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Medicare support
  • Employee Perks: Referral program, employee discount programs, and propane savings

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Power BI semantic models and support the Snowflake data transformation layer, which together serve as the foundation for reporting, self-service analytics, and AI data agents.
  • Support development of the data transformation layer in Snowflake, helping transform raw data into business-ready data that is structured, performant, and ready for downstream consumption.
  • Design and build transformation logic that applies business rules consistently and aligns with the team’s standards and architecture.
  • Publish and maintain well documented and performant Power BI semantic models that enable reporting and self-service.
  • Identify, prioritize, and automate recurring manual processes such as data refreshes, extracts, and report distribution.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable data models and validate that models answer real business questions.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented SQL transformations using dbt, with Git-based version control.
  • Manage data projects end to end, coordinating with IT source system owners, the Data Warehouse team, and business end users from requirements gathering through development, testing, and delivery.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, CI/CD, and documentation practices established by the team.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data quality issues in the transformation and semantic layers.
  • Stay current with Snowflake and reporting platform capabilities and contribute ideas for improving the team’s analytics infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, Statistics, Analytics, or related field).
  • 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, BI development, or a closely related role.
  • Strong SQL skills, including CTEs, window functions, and query performance tuning.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform (e.g., BigQuery, Databricks).
  • 2+ years building Power BI semantic models, with working knowledge of DAX and M.
  • Understanding of semantic layer concepts, star schema design, and dimensional modeling principles.
  • Experience with data transformation tools such as dbt, including Git-based version control.
  • Experience with AI platforms is a plus, particularly integrating AI tools such as LLMs, Snowflake Cortex, or AI agents with enterprise data.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and documentation.
  • Collaborative team player who can work effectively with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders.
  • Passionate about learning new technologies and adapting to changing environments.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen, national, permanent resident, or otherwise authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants must not require visa sponsorship now or in the future

Why Ferrellgas?

At Ferrellgas we’re honored to be part of tight-knit communities across America and thousands of customers’ lives. From our nationwide charitable partnerships with Operation Warm and Operation BBQ Relief to fundraisers for local schools, fire departments, veteran organizations and more, we are always looking for ways to give back to the communities we live in and serve.

Hear from our current employees and discover the people behind Ferrellgas: Employee Testimonials

Ready to take the next step in your career? Apply today and be part of our growing team!

data.description:
We are looking for a Data Engineer with 2–5 years of experience to design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines and analytics-ready datasets. The ideal candidate will have strong SQL and Python or PySpark skills, hands-on experience with cloud data platforms, and the ability to troubleshoot data-quality, performance, and production issues independently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL and ELT pipelines for batch and scheduled data processing.
  • Build and optimize data transformations using SQL, Python, and PySpark.
  • Ingest and integrate data from databases, APIs, files, SharePoint, and cloud storage.

  • Implement data-quality checks, reconciliation controls, monitoring, logging, and failure alerts.

  • Hands-on experience with Python and/or PySpark for data processing and automation.
  • Practical experience building and supporting ETL or ELT pipelines in production.
  • Experience working with large datasets, incremental loads, upserts, schema changes, and partitioned data.
  • Good understanding of relational databases, dimensional modeling, data warehousing, and file formats such as Parquet, CSV, and JSON.
  • Experience with Git or another version-control system and structured deployment practices.

Preferred Skills

data.title: Business Intelligence Analytics Engineer
data.description:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is seeking a Business Intelligence Analytics Engineer to join our BI function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is an executional role providing essential analytics support across the company: you will gather requirements, field ad hoc and recurring data requests, and build the reporting dashboards that leaders across Carrot rely on to make decisions.

You will work hands-on with modern data tooling, including SQL, dbt, and enterprise BI platforms, and partner with teams across the business to translate their questions into clear, trustworthy answers. The BI team is highly cross-functional and sits alongside Data Engineering, making this a strong opportunity to sharpen technical skills while building broad business context in a mission-driven environment.

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build data models in SQL with a focus on correctness, clarity, and reusability
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key business metrics and inform decision-making across the company
  • Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer high-priority business questions from stakeholders across the organization
  • Collaborate with teams across Carrot to understand their data domains, reporting needs, and success metrics
  • Contribute to data quality, documentation, and self-service BI capabilities as the function scales

What Success Looks Like 📈

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly
  • Fully ramped on Carrot's data stack and core data domains, independently owning recurring and ad hoc reporting requests
  • Built strong working relationships with cross-functional partners and established yourself as a reliable analytics resource
  • Improved turnaround and consistency of reporting by creating reusable data models and reducing manual work

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • A Bachelor's Degree
  • Intermediate-to-advanced SQL experience: ability to write advanced queries using joins, common table expressions, and window/analytic functions
  • Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or Power BI) to bring data insights to life for broad audiences
  • Basic statistics proficiency: experiment design, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, probability, and distributions
  • Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical audiences

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data
  • Experience working with healthcare industry data or in other complex, regulated data environments
  • Experience in a high-growth environment
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git preferred)
  • Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations

Why This Role Matters 🧡

Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analytics Engineer, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust.

Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day.

Interview Process 🤝

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes
  4. Performance Task — 60 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation 💰

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $98,000.00- $125,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

data.description:
The Kestra team has over 400 years of experience in the external and internal cardiac medical device markets. The company was founded in 2014 by industry leaders inspired by the opportunity to unite modern wearable technologies with proven device therapies. Kestra’s solutions combine high quality and technical performance with a wearable design that provides the greatest regard for patient comfort and dignity. Innovating versatile new ways to deliver care, Kestra is helping patients and their care teams harmoniously monitor, manage, and protect life.

The Senior Manager, Enterprise Data Platform & Governance owns Kestra’s enterprise data platform and the standards that govern how data is used across the company. Reporting to the CIO, this role leads the transition to Microsoft Fabric, defines the enterprise data architecture, and operationalizes the Master Data Management (MDM) program. The role sets the rules, certified data models, and guardrails that allow analysts embedded in business functions to build their own reports and insights safely and consistently. This is a platform and governance leadership role, not a report development role. The Senior Manager directs outsourced engineering, administration, and development resources today, with the opportunity to build an internal team as the platform matures and serves as a trusted advisor to functional leaders as Kestra builds the governed data foundation required for AI, automation, and its evolving enterprise systems.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:
Data Platform and Architecture

  • Own the design, implementation, and operation of the enterprise data platform, including the Microsoft Fabric transition plan from the current Azure-based environment.
  • Define and maintain the enterprise data architecture, including Lakehouse design, semantic models, data ingestion patterns, and environment strategy across development, test, and production.
  • Manage platform capacity, performance, reliability, and cost, and recommend licensing and capacity adjustments to the CIO.
  • Maintain continuity of enterprise analytics as source systems evolve, including Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and Bonafide, and retire legacy custom reports as they are rebuilt on certified models by functional analysts or delivery resources.
  • Prepare the data platform for AI and automation use cases, including Microsoft Copilot experiences, such as Copilot in Fabric and Power BI and Microsoft 365 Copilot, on governed semantic models, and data products that support embedded insights within business workflows.

Master Data Management

  • Operationalize the MDM program, including master data domains, ownership, stewardship processes, data quality rules, and supporting tools.
  • Partner with functional data owners to establish and sustain stewardship roles and data quality metrics.
  • This role sets enterprise data standards, definitions, quality rules, and controls; data owners decide on the content, quality thresholds, and access for their domains within those standards.

Data Governance and Self-Service Enablement

  • Own governance for all users creating reports, dashboards, and BI content from the data platform, including workspace standards, publishing and certification rules, access controls, and change management.
  • Implement data protection controls in partnership with the Director of IT Security and Compliance, including sensitivity labeling of PHI, PII, and financial data, data loss prevention, and role-based access.
  • Make the governed path the easiest path by providing certified datasets, templates, documentation, training, and office hours for self-service users.
  • Serve as the expert guide and technical mentor to data analysts embedded in functions across the company, raising capability and consistency without becoming the default report developer.
  • Establish clear intake and decision rights that distinguish enterprise data standards, owned by this role, from functional analysis, owned by business teams.

Leadership and Advisory

  • Act as a trusted advisor to functional leaders on data strategy, metrics definitions, and how data can improve decisions and operations.
  • Influence leaders and teams outside direct reporting lines through sound judgment and constructive resolution of competing priorities, and communicate platform roadmaps, risks, and tradeoffs to executive audiences in concise, business-oriented terms.

Resource and Vendor Management

  • Manage outsourced developers, administrators, and other technical resources that support the data platform, including scope, prioritization, quality, and delivery.
  • Support sourcing, statements of work, and supplier performance management for data platformservices, and monitor spending against budget.
  • Coordinate with the Director of Information Technology on application integrations and system changes that affect the data platform.

Compliance and Quality

  • Ensuring enterprise data assets and platform processes comply with HIPAA, SOX, and other applicable requirements.
  • Support validation of data platform components and reports for regulatory and audit readiness, including documentation and retention of validation evidence.
  • Adhere to Pledge of Confidentiality

data.title: Senior Software Developer, Complex Accounts
data.description:
Build something people love

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $169 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual and learn more about how we work.

About the team

The Complex Accounts team builds the accounts that don't fit a standard mould. We own how businesses, from sole proprietorships to corporations with layered ownership, open and manage their accounts with Wealthsimple, along with joint accounts and registered education savings plans (RESPs). As we expand into more account types, the list keeps growing. It's work where accuracy, security, and regulatory requirements are non-negotiable, and we partner closely with operations, compliance, design, and product to make complicated financial structures feel simple for the people using them. We’re part of Data & Engineering, where quality, security, and scalability are the standard, not trade-offs.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Build and evolve the systems that let businesses, joint owners, and families open and manage accounts with Wealthsimple

  • Design data models for complex ownership — corporations, co-owners, and the people behind them

  • Work with compliance and operations partners to turn regulatory requirements into reliable, well-tested software

  • Improve the account opening experience across mobile and web, removing friction wherever clients get stuck

  • Build tools that help our operations teams serve clients faster and handle unusual cases on their own

  • Share on-call responsibilities and fix the root causes of recurring issues

  • Use AI tools as a core part of how you build, and help shape how the team works with them

  • Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code review, documentation, and mentorship

Skills you bring:

  • 5+ years of professional software development, with depth in back-end systems and a track record of shipping production systems that clients and teams depend on

  • Full-stack experience: you’re as comfortable contributing to a client-facing flow on web or mobile as you are to the services running underneath it

  • Experience modelling complex domains and designing systems that handle sensitive data, including authentication, fine-grained authorization, and auditability

  • A track record of shipping in a regulated domain alongside compliance or operations partners

  • An AI-first development workflow that doesn’t compromise on rigour: you use agentic tools day to day and know how to verify their output before it reaches production

  • Clear communication: you can explain a technical trade-off to engineers, compliance partners, and leadership alike

Nice-to-have's:

  • Experience with Ruby on Rails, React / React Native, or TypeScript

  • Familiarity with KYC/KYB processes, including business verification and beneficial ownership

  • Knowledge of Canadian business structures (corporations, trusts, partnerships) or registered accounts like RESPs

  • Experience at a fintech or financial services company

Why Wealthsimple?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year*

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year*

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

*Unlimited paid sick days, Wellness Days and the 90 day away program do not apply to certain roles.

ICYMI

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.

Inclusion Statement: We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. We strongly encourage applications from everyone, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Accessibility Statement: We're committed to an accessible hiring experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We also welcome any feedback on how we can better accommodate candidates with accessibility needs.

AI in Hiring: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but don't replace human judgment – all final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have questions about how your data is used, reach out to us.

data.title: Analytics Engineer III (Data Directorate - FP&A)
data.description:
One of the largest beauty groups in the world, the Grupo Boticário is a Brazilian company present in more than 40 countries. It owns the brands O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, TRUSS, and the marketplace Beleza na Web, in addition to operating licensed products such as Australian Gold, Bio Oil, Nuxe, and Pampers and its B2B division. This interaction among different brands, assets, platforms, franchise network, representatives, distributors, retailers, sellers and suppliers forms the beauty ecosystem of the Grupo Boticário which also offers digital business management solutions for Brazilian retail through its brands Mooz and GAVB. It has more than 19 thousand direct employees, with more than 4 thousand stores in 1,780 Brazilian cities.

Come make beauty with us!


As Analytics Engineer III in the Data Directorate of the Grupo Boticário, you will be the technical link between the Data Platform and the FP&A business areas.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:
• Lead data modeling:Design and maintain robust data layers, ensuring that business rules are translated into clean, efficient and versioned code.
• Ensure reliability:Implement automated data tests, quality monitoring and technical documentation, ensuring that critical product safety and efficacy indicators are 100% reliable.
• Otimizar performance:Work on improving query and pipeline performance, ensuring scalability for the Group's large data volume.
• Act as a business partner:Actively collaborate with Product Managers and Functional Analysts to understand complex pain points and propose proactive data architecture solutions.
• Spread a data culture:Mentor more junior team members (code reviews, best practices) and promote a Self-Service culture for business stakeholders.
• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving:Ability to go beyond the initial request, investigating the root cause of business pain points to propose architectures that solve the real problem. Actively take part in discussions, questioning assumptions and suggesting proactive improvements to processes and the team's development pipeline.

For this position of Analytics Engineer III, we are looking for someone with technical knowledge of modern data architecture who acts as a technical reference for the team, ensuring the scalability and governance of QEC data.
What is indispensable (Must-haves):

  • Requirements Analysis and Autonomy: Ability to work directly with the functional team to lead requirements gathering, translate business needs into technical scope, and independently drive the execution of demands end to end.
  • Advanced SQL Proficiency: Proven experience writing complex and performant queries for data transformation in the Google BigQuery.
  • Data Modeling: Solid experience with dimensional modeling, creation of tables optimized for analytical consumption and modern data architectures (Data Lakehouse), translating business rules into efficient technical schemas.
  • Cloud GCP: Knowledge of Google Cloud Platform services, especially storage and processing strategies.
  • Pipeline Orchestration: Hands-on experience with data flow orchestration tools (Airflow) to manage dependencies, scheduling and failure monitoring.
  • Software Engineering applied to Data: Experience with code versioning (Git), Code Reviews, Pull Requests and CI/CD pipelines.


What will make your eyes light up (Differentiators):

  • Generative AI and Agents: Practical use of GenAI tools (Gemini, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) to accelerate code development, or experience implementing agentes de IA for task automation, data quality and integration of agents into data pipelines.
  • Python: Proficiency in Python for script automation, orchestration or exploratory analysis.
  • Ingestion via APIs: Experience extracting data via third-party APIs (e.g., Google, Meta, Salesforce, etc.), handling authentication, pagination and incremental loads.
  • FinOps and Optimization: Experience monitoring processing costs and latency, proactively refactoring queries for cloud cost efficiency.
  • Advanced data knowledge: Knowledge of data science, statistical models and machine learning is considered a differentiator for the position.

Additional information

Benefits that care and stand out:

No Grupo Boticário, care is our foundation for achieving exponential results. We have a portfolio of more than 20 benefits to take care of your health, well-being and family. Check below.

Insurance for protection and financial peace of mind
